notes.title: BLACK STIGMA Update 1.2.3 – Sep 18
notes.content:
[p][/p][h3][b]- Maintenance Schedule -[/b][/h3][list][*][p]SEP 18 (Thu) 08:00 ~ 09:00 UTC[/p][/*][/list][p]※ Maintenance time may be shortened or extended depending on the progress. Any changes will be announced separately.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]- Patch Notes -[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]\[Balance Adjustments][/b][/h3][p]■ One : Detox Smoke (E) skill adjustments[/p][p]  ㆍChanged the effect so that it now removes harmful effects from the entire area, instead of only a partial area.[/p][p]  ㆍReduced the skill’s activation range by 50%.[/p][p]  ㆍAdjusted the number of charges from 2 → 1.[/p][p]  ㆍUpdated the visual effects.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/d3b29e5b9b486f7781c29ead728a3c5bd1fcfe18.gif"][/img][/p][p]■ Adjusted so that within the smoke effect area of status-inflicting skills, both allies and enemies are obscured from view.[/p][p]  ㆍOne: Poison Gas Grenade(SpaceBAR), Poison Kiss (Q) [/p][p]  ㆍKaira: Rainbow Syndrom(SpaceBar)[/p][p]■ Hand : Updated the visual effects of the WP Shell(Q)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[Content Improvements][/b][/h3][p]■ Added a Beginner Mission page to Challenges and improved mission instructions and reward display for easier understanding.[/p][p]■ Added a Level Info tab to Profile Edit so players can check required EXP and rewards for each account level.[/p][p]■ When purchasing or obtaining an item, right-clicking the “Acquired Item” image now allows quick navigation to its storage location.[/p][p]■ Improved readability of item rarity display by making it color-based for intuitive distinction.[/p][p]■ In Master Costume and Weapon Customization pages, right-clicking on “Unowned” parts that are available for purchase now allows direct purchase.[/p][p]■ In Profile Edit, purchasable profile cards and emblems can now be bought instantly via right-click.[/p][p]■ Applied ally/enemy-identifying colors to Sim’s shield.[/p][p]■ Improved the unnatural in-place rotation animation when Micron is crouching.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[Content Changes][/b][/h3][p]■ Changed so that Battle Pass “Pass Level Up” purchases are only available when the Premium Pass is active.[/p][p]■ When the Battle Pass reaches its maximum level, Battle Coins can now only be obtained through missions, excluding coins earned from battles.[/p][p]■ Removed the Learning Points (Battle EXP Adjustment) system and it will no longer be displayed in the wallet.[/p][p]■ Removed Battle Coins from the main wallet display; they can now be checked only on the Battle Pass page.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[Optimization][/b][/h3][p]■ Optimized the Café map in Team Deathmatch.[/p][p]■ Optimized the Lounge map in Team Deathmatch.[/p][p]■ Optimized effects for status-effect skills that use smoke.[/p][p]■ Optimized character and FX resources.[/p][p]■ Improved mouse rotation responsiveness when using skills.[/p][p]■ Improved issues where character movement appeared choppy or misaligned depending on network conditions.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/h3][p]■ Fixed an issue where the "simultaneous judgment pushback" that occurs when you and an opponent use skills at the same time was also being applied to allies.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where Micron’s Piercing Shot (SpaceBar) and Crush’s Straightforward (E) would not deal damage even when a hit indicator appeared.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where Hollowpoint’s Sticky Bomb (Q) > Type 2 Stabbing skill would fail to grab the target if used at a very short distance.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where using the character’s Roll (L Shift) skill would incorrectly count as a "dodge" against ally attacks.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where status effects from Hand’s WP Shell (Q) and One’s Poison Gas Grenade (SpaceBar) would affect enemies through walls.[/p][p]■ Fixed an intermittent issue where the attached bomb indicator would not appear when using Hollowpoint’s Sticky Bomb (Q).[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where gold chest amounts were displayed twice or numbers under bridges were visible on some Get 'em All maps.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where the weekly mission "Complete n Daily Missions" was not counting progress correctly.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where the number of unread mails in the lobby mailbox did not update immediately when a new mail was received.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where recharged currency was not reflected in the wallet immediately after purchase.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where the remaining time was not displayed in the tooltip when using time-limited buff items.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would momentarily freeze when clicking the "Exit Game" button.[/p][h3]
[b]\[Known Issues][/b][/h3][p]*The following bugs have been identified and are scheduled to be fixed in the next patch.[/p][p]■ Fixed an issue where corpses would occasionally move when certain characters die during combat.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]BLACK STIGMA Team[/p]

notes.title: [Contest] Master Costume Show Challenge!
notes.content: [h3][b]'The world of stylish killers, ‘BLACK STIGMA’![/b][/h3][p]A special event to show off your golden look![/p][p]Take a screenshot of your favorite master wearing a beautiful costume and share it! 📸[/p][h3][/h3][h3]📆 Event Period[/h3][p]From Tuesday, August 26 ~ Thursday, September 11, 02:59 PM (UTC)[/p][p]※ Posts uploaded before the event start date are also eligible.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎁Rewards:[/h3][p]All participants will receive Normal Recruit Ticket x10.[/p][p][/p][h3]👉Participating Channels[/h3][p] - Twitter (X) and Steam Community Hub (Screenshot Menu)[/p][p](* Multiple entries allowed, but rewards are limited to 1 per in-game account)[/p][p][/p][h3]✅How to Participate[/h3][p]1. Play BLACK STIGMA and take a screenshot of your favorite master wearing a beautiful costume.[/p][p]( * Original costumes are excluded; all other costumes are eligible. )[/p][p]2. Share your screenshot publicly on BLACK STIGMA Steam Community Hub or the official Twitter (X) event post via comment or quote post.[/p][p]3. Submit the \[Google Form]<[url="https://forms.gle/Kd5maVSTiPRrdRek9"]https://forms.gle/Kd5maVSTiPRrdRek9[/url]> to verify your participation.[/p][p][/p][p]Tip: Check out the guide on how to upload screenshots.[/p][p][url="https://blackstigma.oqupie.com/portal/2980/article/81127"]https://blackstigma.oqupie.com/portal/2980/article/81127[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]📢 Winner Announcement[/h3][p]Scheduled for Friday, September 12[/p][p]Check the Discord \[EVENT] channel for results.[/p][p][/p][h3]✨ Reward Distribution[/h3][p]Starting sequentially from September 15 (Mon)[/p][p]Rewards will be sent via in-game mail to the nickname submitted for verification.[/p][p][/p][h3]📌 Notes:[/h3][p] - Only screenshots personally captured by you are eligible. Screenshots using someone else’s content will be disqualified.[/p][p] - Screenshots must be shared publicly to be eligible. Private posts will be disqualified.[/p][p] - If identical images are submitted, only the earliest submission will be recognized.[/p][p] - Submitting the Google Form is mandatory for participation. notes.title: [Dev Note] Part-19 : Reflections on NextFest Feedback
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/ae13e799742e334d732a85d42e9be1876b9c7d1b.png[/img]


Hello, this is Kwon Dae Ho, Executive Producer.

It’s been a while since the Steam Next Fest test held at the end of February, and I would like to take this opportunity to connect with you.
We truly value the enthusiastic engagement shown during Next Fest, from exploring the Steam store page to accessing the game.

Regardless of the meaningful outcomes we achieved, participants gave us a variety of feedback on Black Stigma, prompting us to significant internal discussion.
In the end, we decided to enhance the game prior to the Early Access launch by focusing on the main concerns highlighted by our community.


[h4][ Issues Identified in NextFest ][/h4]

Participants from multiple channels have pointed out several critical concerns:

1)	Combat balance (especially active skills)
2)	Lack of content (modes/rewards)
3)	Poor delivery of essential information (UI/tutorials, etc.)

Here is how we are actively working on enhancements in these key issues.


[h3][ Issue 1: Adjusting Gun & Skill Balance ][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/dc2b2f35023153487c10a34ce43b03de42a5a71e.jpg[/img]
We focused on creating flashy and unique character actions, but many players perceived that active skills were somewhat overpowered compared to shooting in the recent build.
Even those who effectively used skills and achieved high K/D or win rates shared similar opinions. As a result, the intended balance between shooting and skills was not fully realized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/8b0fed42851e1370638976691b28170082ba098a.jpg[/img]
Therefore, we are working on:
(1) Ensuring the effective and rewarding use of skills in a strategic manner
(2) Adjusting damage output and hit assessment to improve the overall offense-defense experience


[h3][ Issue 2: New Game Modes for Enhanced Variety ][/h3]

The previous test build included:
(1) Team-based elimination (Kill ‘Em All) 
(2) Team-based gold snatching (Get ‘Em All) 
(3) 1v1 battles (VS Mode)

However, many users expressed a desire for additional options, which we understood as a need to reduce the stress of competition and complex rules.
In response, we are developing a new PVP mode that allows players to focus solely on fighting against enemies.
This mode follows a simple rule, and even if you're defeated, you'll be able to return to the battlefield within a few seconds.
Additionally, this mode will accommodate more participants than our existing modes.
We hope this makes the game experience more accessible and delivers an enjoyable, relaxed combat environment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/d9d18c356a2ceb28b5c7a9461cdea40b82d36ce5.jpg[/img]


[h4][ Conclusion ][/h4]

In addition to balancing and the introduction of new PVP modes, we are also enhancing aspects such as the UI in response to your feedback.
We’ll share more updates as our development advances, and we have additional information to share.


Sincerely,

Kwon Dae-ho, Executive Producer

notes.title: [Dev Note] Part-18 : Invitation to Steam Next Fest Test
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/2599fb5bf523fa7806cfe893af6e37ce062292ae.png[/img]


Hello, I am Kwon Dae Ho, the Executive Producer.

BLACK STIGMA has been meticulously refined through field tests in the game shows and global tests. We have decided to participate in the STEAM Next Fest in February 2025, and would like to inform the results of our development in advance.


[h4][ Test Schedule and Overview ][/h4]

[b]1. Test Schedule[/b]
The test will take place during Steam Next Fest, running from February 24 to March 3 (Pacific Time).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/9e35f3618bca7d5fe90a0dccd3af24f7fb2ced45.png[/img]

[b]2. Service and Matchmaking Regions [/b]

Unlike previous tests, this one will be conducted as a global one-server service, allowing all players to participate on the same server regardless of location.
However, there will be seven matchmaking regions to ensure smooth gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/7ee8dd24cb5424f9bb11211a4af62694c733b3db.png[/img]
The game will assess the network status between the player and each matchmaking region, displaying a list of available regions along with their connection quality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/bc6e55e7c55cb4908f0f563e75555ea0c89dbfce.png[/img]
Regions expected to have extremely poor network performance will be unavailable for selection. Players can choose from the available regions and apply for matchmaking accordingly.


[h4][ Key Test Content Scope ][/h4]
The Next Fest version will feature 13 playable characters and three PvP modes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/7cc64cb9ee058a8b2ba707fe76867e2d4c5227ac.jpg[/img]
Kaira, a new character, will debut alongside the 12 existing members of the A.S. and AB killer groups. As a K-pop artist and intelligence agent, Kaira brings a unique playstyle to the game.
 
The available game modes include: Kill ‘Em All – a standard elimination mode,
Get ‘Em All – a 3 vs 3 vs 3 cash grab mode,
and  Versus – a newly introduced 1 vs 1 duel mode.

Additionally, the following core elements will be showcased in this test:

1. Combat system improvements
2. Enhanced character identity
3. Game mode specifications
4. Weapon specifications
5. Introduction of Battle Pass
6. UI/UX improvements


[h4][ Combat System Improvements ][/h4]
The overall combat experience has been refined to be "faster and more intuitive."

[u]1. Shooting has been made easier, and the first-person aiming mode is now more intuitive.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/f3ec32ca8332cc830c95e3b424ef751d7984ec36.gif[/img]
(based on the result of testing auto fire with the same Ruger Mark.4 Lite basic model)

Accuracy, the key factor affecting shooting difficulty, has been significantly improved.
As a result, bullets now land closer to the aiming reticle, making a noticeable difference, especially in moving shots or rapid-fire scenarios. Players familiar with the previous Black Stigma test will feel this improvement even more.


[u]2. The controls for character-specific active skills have been improved.[/u]

Previous test versions aimed to reflect realistic martial arts and combat techniques, but this resulted in slow and frustrating controls.
To address this, we made significant adjustments to the game’s setting and overhauled character animations accordingly.
As a result, skills now flow more smoothly, allowing for quick directional changes during skill execution, making them feel more responsive and natural.
Further details on these skill improvements will be covered in the [Enhanced Character Identity] section.


[h4][ Enhanced Character Identity ][/h4]
Character individuality has been further refined based on extensive review.

[u]1. Skill compositions have been made more dynamic and visually engaging. [/u]
As mentioned in Developer Note #16, we’ve reinforced the visual appeal of each character’s stylish traits.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/da076a396356277c3187f821e71476961f8ab92f.png[/img]

These improvements are not just cosmetic. Animation speed, hit detection, and skill responsiveness have all been optimized to enhance the overall gameplay experience.

[u]2. Character voices have been fully implemented. [/u]
As Black Stigma is a hero shooter that emphasizes character identity, over 20 voice actors were carefully selected to minimize cases where one actor voices multiple characters.

For now, only Korean and English voiceovers are available, but additional language options will be introduced in the future.


[h4][ Game Mode Specifications ][/h4]
The core of any PvP shooter lies in its game modes and maps.
The Kill ‘Em All and Get ‘Em All modes from previous tests remain intact, while a new Versus mode has been introduced for 1 vs 1 battles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/659ad404194976c77320ad7a6134b52a28ae64dd.png[/img]
[b]1) Kill ‘Em All Overview & Improvements [/b]
Kill ‘Em All is a 3 vs 3 elimination mode, where teams must eliminate all opponents to win a round, with the first team to win four rounds securing victory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/7dfaad92e7d7968cb4dbe6217e98f885d76612b0.png[/img]
The mode will feature four maps. Extension Works, Old Manor, and Abandoned Subway which were introduced before, and the newly added map 'Sewers.'
Sewers features a multi-layered central structure to increase vertical combat encounters.
The three returning maps have been slightly downsized to encourage faster engagements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/8d8facbe099ad460b5cf42d72c8f017eb6e646ad.png[/img]

[b]2) Get ‘Em All Overview & Improvements [/b]
Get ‘Em All is a 3 vs 3 vs 3 cash grab mode where teams compete to collect and secure the most gold. Players must eliminate opponents, gather gold from the ground, and hack enemy vaults to steal funds. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/e3151af727c7916c0e110b80f993cecd9a5d909f.png[/img]

The ‘Museum’ is centered around a central hall, with each team’s safe located a relatively short distance away. Through this structure, the intention was to create a large-scale melee in the center at a faster tempo than ‘Violet Hotel’
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/4d28606a3a382947fe025b3c9c0d951e0dbe98c9.png[/img]

[b]3) Versus Overview & Improvements [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/eeeb5178b1cfade5e3e11988a6d55f9a8c80a8e7.jpg[/img]
The newly added Versus mode was first introduced as a prototype at the 2024 Thailand Game Show. As explained in Developer Note #15, two players select three characters each to engage in head-to-head combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/0432f5898c574e5d2df9d6b129a18933070a76b3.png[/img]
The Next Fest version features three maps, with victory going to the player who secures two rounds first.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/3921ca9582ee05bdd138c715d5016410f42b2dd8.png[/img]
Additional PvE content will be available for training and practice:
[list]
[*] Training Ground: Practice with dummies while freely swapping characters and weapons.
[*] Kill ‘Em All (Training): A 3 vs 3 elimination mode with AI bots.
[*] Get ‘Em All (Training): A 3 vs 3 vs 3 cash grab mode with AI bots.
[/list]

[h4][ Weapon Specifications ][/h4]
Weapon mechanics have been streamlined to allow for faster adaptation and intuitive gameplay.
 
[b]1) Available Weapon Types [/b]
The test will feature nine types of weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/eb1c6895af762c9ef7fe58d1d0e0d31bdb311295.png[/img]
[b]2) Simplified Weapon Parts Collection & Customization [/b]
All nine base weapons are now pre-unlocked, eliminating the need for purchases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/824be5bba163239b86580b2878d2eb50623ca6be.png[/img]
Each default weapon comes pre-customized to match its intended combat role. Players can use these recommended setups or modify them at any time to fit their personal playstyle.
Weapon part customization has been adjusted to reduce stress and allow for easier attachment and detachment.


[h4][ Battle Pass Introduction ][/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/e68606fc8ff612d6cab4fe6d464b1911d86461f2.png[/img]
A Battle Pass system will be introduced to provide mid-to-long-term progression through missions and rewards.
The Next Fest version will serve as a trial run, with all missions and rewards completable in approximately 30 hours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/47181962091445d7a6b9a733aa34f7336273a32b.png[/img]
The new character Kaira is one of the rewards and can be unlocked by completing just 20% of the pass.


[h4][ UI/UX Improvements ][/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/d5068dd265921b18fc6972d39d34c71d94a97f6d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/586640b415e045e993f82a08af425d8753b999d3.jpg[/img]
The entire UI/UX has been redesigned compared to previous test builds.


[h4][ Conclusion ][/h4]
We sincerely appreciate the support and feedback we have received over the years. This Steam Next Fest test is an important step toward our Early Access launch, and the insights gathered will help us refine the game further.

To show our gratitude, players who participate in Steam Next Fest will receive exclusive rewards that will carry over into Early Access. Limited-edition costumes of 'Hollowpoint' and 'One,' and four special items celebrating the Year of the Blue Snake (2025): A weapon ornament, a weapon sticker, a profile card, and an emblem
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/4a59b52962cee9f50bf9ba392bfd081957127174.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy Steam Next Fest, and we look forward to your feedback and support. See you on February 24.

Sincerely, 

Kwon Dae-ho, Executive Producer

notes.title: [Dev Note] Part-13 : Tasks Following the 2nd Global Test
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/8cb0f2f0775aaf990cf64055c45b08f02633b183.png[/img]

[b][ Intro ] [/b]

Hello everyone, I am Kwon Dae Ho, the Executive Producer.

Before I begin, I sincerely thank all the testers who participated in this test with great interest.

Black Stigma conducted its 2nd Global Test (hereafter referred to as ‘CBT’) across four regions—Asia, North America, Europe, and South America—from July 19th for four days.

Since its early development, BoldPlay Games has been identifying what users find enjoyable and trendy through Alpha tests and Global Testing Tours. This CBT was effectively the final test to finalize the game plans.

We analyzed the results of this test to reevaluate what testers thought about Black Stigma. Here, I share the insights gained and the development direction that will be reflected in early access. 



[b][ Results Overview ] [/b]

Despite minimal advertising, many testers have joined in and enjoyed the game as they did in the last Global Testing Tour, providing clear and sharp feedback from their varied gaming experiences. 

[u]Positive Responses[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/0ef539db175efda78df45a0ce15e551e5e4ff350.png[/img]

The positive feedback about Black Stigma was mainly made in these two areas. 

[list]
[*] Character design and art style
[*] The concept of pistol-based shooting combined with melee combat skills 
[/list]

[u]Negative/Improvement Needed Feedback[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/5b114b577c8230d6848183cfe68a2d6ac99edffb.png[/img]

There were significant issues with game optimization and network quality. We apologize for not accommodating and preparing for various possibilities, which led to difficulties in conducting smooth tests.

We've summed up other complaints and suggestions for improvement like this. 

[list]
[*] Lack of intuitiveness and tactile satisfaction when using guns and active skills 
[*] Frustration with using active skills
[*] Lacking structure in PVP modes
[*] Unrefined and user-unfriendly interface
[*] Service quality issues 
[/list]



[b][ Improvements to Make ] [/b] 

[olist]
1. Clearly Express the Game Identity
[/olist]

We will adjust the balance to make both pistol shooting and melee action meaningful and improve targeted shooting to enhance the tactile experience of firing a gun.

Active skills will be made quicker and more intuitive, allowing players to proceed or cancel at will, reducing frustration.

All these changes aim to make Black Stigma an intuitive game that allows players to engage enemies without lengthy learning. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/c7d9a5d13ce71c87765f1c2ac182b512a337b43c.png[/img]

[i]<  'Hardworker Crush' was the most lacking in intuitive skill usage - our goal is to improve the delay and operability of most skills so that they feel more intuitive to use > [/i]

[olist]
2.  Strengthening the Structure of Game Modes for More Intense PVP 
[/olist]

We plan to modify PVP game modes to be more dynamic and fiercely competitive.  

This includes revising the rules of each game mode to minimize the repetition of the same combat scenarios in a match.

Additionally, improvements to the PVP mode map structures are planned to foster more intense battles. New maps are also being developed with this basis. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/402d2337cb9cf48a0a848bb12a8c85ade4edfe90.png[/img]

[i]< New map creation process for an underground waterway concept - we are making a map with multiple layers and will install materials that bullets can penetrate to create more variables > [/i]

We also think that we need to work on improving gameplay to add more elements that boost showmanship and competitiveness in combat, especially in places like Get 'em All, we're working on adding devices to better showcase your performance. 

[olist]
3.  Enhancing Information Delivery and UI/UX 
[/olist]

We will improve the overall interface and notifications to naturally convey the basic game systems. Instead of easily-skippable tutorials, we aim to use intuitive expressions to explain the features of Black Stigma.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/a2a98dd511997eaee0e858cb9cc8b2f3d0a7f6ef.png[/img]

[i]< We tried to help new testers get settled in CBT with a tutorial - in the next version, we want to deliver game information through a more intuitive UI/UX > 
[/i]

We will also improve the UI design and fonts that contributed to a poor first impression, focusing on color schemes and layouts and applying appropriate fonts for different languages.

[olist]4.  Enhancing Details for a more Standard and Completed Game Service [/olist]

We will address the deficiencies in in-game content and basic service standards noted during the beta test.  

This includes adding announcer voices to help players grasp various combat situations and introducing character-specific voices suitable for the hero shooter genre.

We are also committed to optimizing the game itself, eliminating bugs, and ensuring there are no unpleasant experiences during gameplay.

And lastly, efforts will be made to minimize delays/disconnections due to server communication or network issues. 



[b][ Conclusion ][/b]

Beyond these improvement plans, there are many other concerns we need to address to achieve commercial-level game service standards. The content shared here represents major development directions, and we are preparing to refine these details further. We will continue to communicate with you and finalize the game production through ongoing updates.

We received exceptionally insightful feedback during the test period, which helped us understand the level of quality and gameplay our testers expect. Once again, I want to sincerely thank everyone who participated in the four-day test and left valuable feedback.



Producer Kwon Dae Ho

notes.title: [Dev Note] Part-12 : Invitation to the 2nd Global Test
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/26c65f6c86ff7853f2d95b2fa467f06c680548b3.png[/img]

[b][ Intro ] [/b]

Hello, I am Kwon Dae Ho, the Executive Producer.
Since our last global test, we have finalized the game's direction, and we want to share our vision with you.
So, we have prepared the '2nd Global Test' where you can experience the core elements of the game yourself.


[b][Test Schedule and Instructions][/b]

The test will run from July 19th for four days and will be run in all regions across the world at the same time.
Regions are configured based on previous test results to ensure the best experience, and you will be automatically placed in the optimal game region according to your location.
(1)Asia(East East + Southeast Asia), (2)North America, (3)South America, (4)Europe

Those of you that have participated in the previous tests can join without additional steps, while new participants can join by clicking the 'Play Test Application' button.

[b][ Main Test Contents ][/b]

This version reflects feedback from the previous global test, with significant changes in the following areas.
1. Combat Elements Changes
2. Game Mode Improvements
3. Gun System Improvements
4. Introduction of Costume System


[b][ Combat Elements Changes ][/b]

We received extensive feedback on combat, the core part of the game from the last test; and we've made these two major changes:
A. Adjusting Shooting Difficulty and Combat Skill Balance
We enhanced the effectiveness of shots by easing aiming difficulty, reducing recoil, enhancing headshots, and increasing magazine capacity.
Active skills remain powerful but require skillful evasion of intensified enemy shootings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/e2d8958d72cbb524bc420421fd40aa4654271a59.gif[/img]

B. Added Detection System
We also introduced a booster function that will reveal nearby enemy positions. When activated, it allows temporary visibility of enemy locations regardless of obstacles.
Use the detection booster strategically to surprise camping enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/296b83f3fd79244319505a1be9206a52740a03ac.gif[/img]

[b][ Game Mode Improvements ] [/b]

A. New Game Mode ‘Get ‘Em All’ is added
The less popular 'Team Deathmatch' mode is replaced with 'Get ‘Em All,' which focuses on accumulating more gold than the opponent rather than simply eliminating them.
This new mode offers fresh rules, making it enjoyable for both beginners and experienced players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/8a09596ab981a3df30c9b0e21a5a797c83aa4329.gif[/img]

B. Existing ‘Kill ‘Em All’ Mode Improvement
To prevent one-sided matches, we added a team revival system. Once per match, a surviving team member can revive a downed ally each round.
It was difficult to turn the tide of battle once one team began to be outnumbered, but this can potentially turn the tide of the game, if one side successfully revives their downed allies; adding a dramatic element to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/d94f46ed329eb8245a2c124ef520b3cbe51b6eac.gif[/img]

[b][ Gun System Improvements ] [/b]

Considering the importance of guns in a shooting game, we also focused on the gun system. This improvement was made to make differences in individual preferences rather than absolute values. This led to the introduction of the ‘Gun Customization System.’
Previously, we'd set up features and looks as presets and ranked them accordingly. But now, instead of presets with determined performance and value, we're letting players customize every single piece to fit their needs.
Players will be faced with the decision of whether to go for clunky but reliable gun performance or unique and powerful stats or special looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/d47ec7458e02c07f2875162f5fba9404b604ab0c.jpg[/img]

[b][ Introduction of Costume System ] [/b]

A system to change the appearance of Masters will be added. Initially, some master appearances will be released on a trial basis, with more diverse concepts to follow.
The Master's appearance would be separated into head and body parts, and the players will be able to mix and match various head and body parts they acquire in their own combinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/ade1273d9f828f449549c1b30f884274ee647371.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/7c09cf12911e8a95526aa954d6339c77b54399d2.jpg[/img]

[b][ Plans After the Test ][/b]

We plan to participate in the Steam Next Fest in October and will introduce new features such as the battle pass, new Masters, and new maps.
By the end of the year, we aim to launch the Early Access service with all systems and content finalized.

[b][ Conclusion ][/b]

The valuable feedback from the previous global test helped solidify the game's core and direction. We extend our gratitude for your contribution.
We also want to offer a small token of appreciation for our testers — exclusive '2 Frontier Masters-piece and Accessory Set' available only through participating in this test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/86431c2c38e77f203fb64b966aa58ef200c42476.png[/img]

We look forward to your active participation and are ready to listen to every piece of feedback. See you on July 19th.
Thank you.

Producer Kwon Dae Ho

notes.title: [Dev Note] Part-11 : Game Mode Development
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/bef347f0415415f558e99393d5f5e6a3ab601e45.png[/img]

[h5][ Intro ] [/h5]

Hello, everyone. I am Kwon Dae Ho, the executive producer of Black Stigma. 

We have been working continuously to make our shooting game more enjoyable, and we've shared many directions for improvement through our developer notes.

Today, ahead of the upcoming playtest, we would like to introduce the 'game modes' that we are fine-tuning until the very last moment. Based on the reactions from players during the last Global Testing Tour, let's see what game modes you can experience in the next test. 

[hr][/hr]
[h5][ Reactions to Existing Game Modes ] [/h5]

In previous tests, we featured the 'Kill 'Em All' mode, a free-for-all style mode, and the 'Team Death Match' mode, where teams compete for the most kills within a time limit. We thought these modes provided familiar fun with simple rules, as proven in other PVP games.  

However, we were able to see that most users were enjoying the 'Kill 'Em All,' and 'Team Death Match' had very low usage unless specific events were held on the mode. We intended 'Team Death Match' to be a fun chaos where beginners and skilled players could mingle casually. But, judging by its low usage rate and player feedback, we realized this mode did not convey our intended experience. 

Also, despite the popularity of 'Kill 'Em All' mode, there were many complaints and suggestions regarding the enjoyment factors. The main issues were the lack of crucial mechanisms to turn the tide and the unfair advantage for campers using the third-person view. 

To address these issues, [u][b]we added several elements to enhance the fairness, and the possibility to turn the tide in 'Kill 'Em All' mode, and worked to replace[/b][/u] the 'Team Death Match' with a newly developed game mode.

[h5][ Improvements to 'Kill 'Em All ][/h5]

To resolve the existing key issues, we added two systems: 'Revival' and 'Detection.' 

Revival System: Allows limited revivals per round by teammates. Imagine reviving your teammates stealthily even when outnumbered. Just by restoring the outnumbered situation to even the numbers, you might already be carrying your team! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/d94f46ed329eb8245a2c124ef520b3cbe51b6eac.gif[/img]

Detection System: This system was developed as a booster that reveals all nearby enemies for a certain period of time, even those hiding behind structures! We believe this detection booster will make the game more dynamic and strategic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/f2f04cc81b6559681d89fb140c0fdff68685a0fa.gif[/img]

[h5][  New Game Mode: 'Get ‘Em All ] [/h5]

Get ‘Em All' can be summarized as a 'cash grab' concept map.

The goal of this new mode is to[b] 'provide an objective other than killing and to allow beginners and skilled players' [/b]to enjoy together. Here are its features: 

[u]1) Victory Objective: The team with the most money wins.  [/u]

While killing enemies helps secure money, other actions can also yield significant funds. Players can collect randomly spawned money or steal money accumulated by the enemy to contribute to their team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/1ea8c2493c8586ad0baef0719b07c66f758de43d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/9bc13242a945ec99322e9d04d6e6542c5a9a32f7.png[/img]

[u]2) Total of 9 players fight in a 3 vs. 3 vs. 3 Format. [/u]

Unlike traditional 'Red team vs. Blue team' matches, a three-team format increases the chances of dynamic and unpredictable gameplay that will make the skill of a player even more important. Depending on the situation, other teams could be enemies or allies. Tactical and strategic decisions will be more crucial along with pure combat skills. 


[hr][/hr]
[h5][ Conclusion ][/h5]

In the upcoming playtest, we will present these improved and newly developed game modes.  

Kill 'Em All,' with its enhanced comeback potential and fairness, will be a battleground for testing each other's skills, while 'Get ‘Em All,' with its unpredictable and chaotic nature, will be a mode that anyone can enjoy casually. 

We hope you play both modes extensively in the next playtest and share your thoughts and suggestions for further improvement. 

Thank you.

[b]Best Regards, 
Producer Kwon Dae Ho[/b]

notes.title: [Dev Note] Part-10 : Development & Service Plan 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/505475619f804a8ee06e257f5cfb11d05e5f9b04.png[/img]


[h5][ Intro ] [/h5]

Hello, everyone. I am Kwon Dae Ho, the executive producer of Black Stigma. 

'Today we'd like to share with you a recap of the development tasks we've been working on, and share our full service schedule for the year 2024.

First, let's take a look at some of the improvements we've implemented through the Global Testing Tour.

[hr][/hr]
[h5][ Game Change Status ] [/h5]

We have been sharing some of the more organized or high-priority issues in the Dev notes, but the overall list of improvements is as follows 

[list]
[*] Improving the ratio of shooting and action
[*] Introducing Gun Customization 
[*] Reorganizing Master Positions and Skills
[*] Game Mode Changes
[*] Introducing the New User Support System 
[*] UI/UX Improvements
[/list]

To maximize the impact of these valuable player feedback, we're undergoing various reinventions in all areas of the game.

And we're pushing development even harder than we did during last year's Global Testing Tour, to accomplish that goal. 

[h5][ Schedule for the Second Half of 2024 ][/h5]

As we make progress on these game-wide improvements, we're excited to share our service Roadmap for the year 2024. 

[list]
[*]  July: Hold Second Global Test (CBT)
[*]  October: Participate in Steam Next Fest
[*]  November ~ December: Begin Early Access (OBT) 
[/list]

[h5][ Notice on the Second Global Test (CBT) in July ][/h5]

This is a version that incorporates most of the basic gameplay feedback we received from players during the first Global Testing Tour at the end of last year, and the goal is to [u]"show people who enjoyed the original GTT that we've listened to their feedback and get validation on the direction we're taking." 
[/u]

This will be followed by Early Access before 2024 passes, which will be the de facto launch of the service. To that end, the game will be shown at Steam Next Fest in October with the version that includes all development items, followed by a few weeks of final debugging and polishing before going into Early Access. 

[hr][/hr]
[h5][ Conclusion ] [/h5]

Our plan has always been to launch Early Access within 2024,
and we're working hard to make sure that plan doesn't change.

We hope that you'll follow and join us during this journey of Black Stigma during the first half of 2024. 

Thank you.


[b]Best Regards, 
Producer Kwon Dae ho[/b]

notes.title: [Dev Notes] Part-9: GTT Feedback - Chapter 4 Position Introduction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/b436eed8650a2c208bd00eebfc5addc110844336.png[/img]


[h5][ Intro ] [/h5]

Hello, everyone. I am Kwon Dae Ho, the executive producer of Black Stigma.

As a follow-up to our last test, it's time to talk about Active Skills, which were the second most important factor after Shooting.

As we've shown in our testing, the Master Characters in Black Stigma have been developed with distinctive role positions. The four positions are as follows: 'Marksman', 'Striker', 'Infiltrator', and 'Disruptor'.

Over the past few months, our development direction has been 'It's a shooter game, let's make shooting more fun and less stressful,' and as a result, the shooting system has changed quite a bit, and the role position distinctions we have set up has become somewhat irrelevant.

This is why we're reorganizing the four position classifications to make them clearer and more representative of the actual combat in the game.


[hr][/hr]
[h5] [ Four Positions ] [/h5]

'The Masters of Black Stigma are categorized into four position classifications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/cb1bdf59c375208ff7ccb2c41d0746a92c9883b7.png[/img]

[i]This is an in-development version, and there may be changes to the Master character's skillset and subsequent changes to the position arrangements.

The old 'Marksman' position has become somewhat ambiguous due to changes in the shooting system over the past few updates, and we've replaced it with the 'Long-Ranger' (tentative name) position name, which is characterized by superior firepower at long distances. We expect these four role positions to move in the following general patterns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/190eb1f44674876982763accb620ca3b8c1355a3.png[/img]

'In today's developer's note, we're going to give you a brief overview of the direction we're taking for each of the positions we're currently planning.


[h5][ STRIKER ] [/h5]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/cb48b11988b66543a23faf407259b2c1ae426c1e.png[/img]

'First, we set up TEN, PARABELLUM, NANO, and PAPER as Striker position.
They'll be the ones on the front lines, boldly charging forward and quickly taking out enemies in close quarter combat.

They will have the following attributes.

[list]
1) Skill sets that consists of only strong melee Active Skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/976391a18c4a6197642c5694f39d119a61fddb6b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/d18c83bca129ec09da615c3aab80288aa1a1f494.gif[/img]

2) A counter skill that neutralizes an enemy's melee Active Skill will be given
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/d2116868a2fc63bd032a7602d971c254dcd63732.gif[/img]
[/list]
These four Masters received some minor skill balance adjustments to fit the redefined Striker position, especially for Nano, who was given a completely different style, we created a new skill and revamped it to serve as 'Striker Nano'.

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/5ba7b51d4460b8495b2eeaa856e5b5ca755c29db.gif[/img]
[i]'Nano's Space Skill (Same as past Sliding Grab)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/44443a0c27716cd149578ddd9fbbdf24b6370997.gif[/img]
[i]Nano's E Skill (Hit with dagger swings to chain into grappling skill)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/af61ff3cffd3ff629c453356bf9e0155f0a67f34.gif[/img]
[i]Nano's Q Skill (New Nano-only Counter attack Skill)[/i]
[/list]


[h5][ INFILTRATOR ] [/h5]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/487fa06587e349fb1d8de054ecf6369b59612842.png[/img]

In the Infiltrator position, we've placed TWIN, GRASPER, and the new Master, who is neither A.S. nor A.B., but the new Master will be a member of a third faction and will be one of the driving forces in the new story.

They specialize in quick movements and are tasked with ambushing enemies when and where they least expect it.

Members of this position will have the following attributes.

[list]
[*] They will have a dash skill, which is useful in melee combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/2572a1e54baa867572423f8d1499e669909bbc5a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/93e18866f67fe7f6475a390d7ff3df55adef9ab6.gif[/img]
[/list]

'The new Master, newly assigned to the Infiltrator position, is being prepared as a character who does Taekwondo. And will use fast movement speed and powerful kicking skills to subdue enemies.

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/ff7665555258788ddcca0495c4bdfdc74e6c0def.gif[/img]
[i]The new Master will quickly get in close with the Dash skill and unleash fierce aerial spin kicks[/i]

[h5][ DISRUPTOR ] [/h5]

The Disruptor position currently includes ONE, and HAND, but we are planning to add another new Master. The new Master assigned to the Disruptor position will also be in a new storyline faction, similar to the previously announced new Master in the Infiltrator position.
They will use non-attack-type skills like Smoke/Flash to turn the tide of battle. These skills can be used offensively or defensively, depending on the Master.

[list]
1) Non-attack-type Skill: Offensive Use example
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/8b90b6483fd53987fd82e572d4201802153e2885.gif[/img]

2) Non-attack-type Skill: Defensive Use example

[i]The scene in which the area of Hand's white phosphorus coal is being removed by Ms. One's new-coming purification-bomb skill before she enters.[/i]
[/list]
'The newest member of the Disruptor position Master is a shield-wielding character that uses Combat Police skills. While they don't have the high-damage active skills of the Striker position, they are being developed to be able to take the lead and protect their allies with solid defensive skills.

[list]

[h5][ LONG-RANGER  ] [/h5]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/b46d8a1d6301fbefb4400c6a82b1f45871eadee9.png[/img]

'One of the positions we had in the test service was 'MARKSMAN (Shooting)', which we changed to 'Long-Ranger(tentative name)' and re-categorized each master based on the new criteria, resulting in HOLLOWPOINT, ZERO, CRUSH, and HEAVY being in the Long-Ranger position.
We intended to give Long-Ranger positions an advantage in situations where you have some distance between you and the enemy, rather than close-range combat.

We're considering one or two of the following characteristics for them.

[list]
1) One of them is to give Throwing Skills that enable them to take down enemies in an instant with powerful one-hit skills.

These Long-Ranger positions will be responsible for overwhelming the enemy with great firepower from the center to the rear of the friendly forces.

In an effort to organize these skill sets, we're reorganizing the previously ambiguous positions to make them more rational.

Using these four positions as a base, we're also working on the fighting styles of our new characters. Stay tuned for more updates to the original 12 and the new Master Characters that will be joining them.

Producer Kwon Dae Ho[/b]

notes.title: [Season 2] Person Information – Gray Heavy
notes.content:
[h3]Person Information – Gray Heavy[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/c24a0d416ecf44ec50d774616b74e771b66a163f.png[/img]

[b][ Character Introduction ][/b]
[list]
[*] Code Name:  Gray Heavy (Affiliation: A.B. Gray Crows)
[*] Role within the organization:  Youngest in the A.B. organization, responsible for reconnaissance and assassination
[*] Real name: Ксения (Kseniya) [ Kindness, hospitality ]
[/list]
She was recruited into the organization by Gray Hand. Following the Gray Crows' rule that members must be of age to be sent on dangerous missions, she joined as the youngest member when she turned 19. Hand keeps giving her big and small tasks to see what she's capable of, but she always starts things off with a bang, but ends up messing up and failing to finish the job.

When she was 12 years old , she killed her mother with her own hands. In her home at the time, one of the many poverty-stricken homes in Area 13. Her father, who had died in an accident several years earlier after heading to a construction site to earn money, was a distant memory for her. Due to the death of all her guardians, she was placed in an orphanage. As for her murder of kin, she was given probation due to mitigating circumstances, including her young age and disadvantaged home environment.

When she reached the age where she was no longer under the care of the orphanage, she turned to theft to feed her hunger. Which eventually led to her committing other acts of violence and murder and was taken to a juvenile prison. While in prison, she heard rumors of a secret organization that works on the side of workers and the poor, and she miraculously escapes from prison to find it. Her journey took her to the turf of the Gray Crows, where she was taken in by the Gray Hand, who had just become their leader.


[b][ Position ][/b]

 - Long-Ranger
[list]
[*] There's no 'covert' or 'subtlety,' she just thoughtlessly shoots from the hip and expose herself to the fullest. It's not uncommon for members acting together with her to be troubled and frustrated because she did not follow the plan.
[*] But Gray Paper and Gray Hand, having gotten a sense of her personality, use her as a distraction so they can accomplish their 'real mission' on the other side.
[/list]

[b][ Specs ][/b]
[list]
[*] Age :  20
[*] Height : 169 cm
[*] Weight :  52 kg
[*] Physique :  Skinny, pale, and blind in the right eye from a childhood injury
[*] Trained Sport : None
[*] Rival : Mr. Hollowpoint, Gray Hand
[*] Buddy : Gray Paper
[*] Likes : Daydreaming about being the protagonist of a graphic, violent scene.
[*] Dislikes : Depression pills (especially the drowsiness that comes with it), admonishment from others
[/list]

[b][ Character Attributes ][/b]

[i]"Who am I? Kikiki... Please call me the ‘Kind Witch’♡"[/i]
[list]
[*] A mad witch who killed her own mother'. Is the nickname she got in the world.
[*] Her real name, Kseniya, was given to her by her mother to remind her to be kind, but ironically, her desperate circumstances have led her to live the opposite of her name. 
[*] She enjoys exaggerated makeup and outfit fashion to cover up her appearance that hints at a difficult childhood. 
[*] When being assigned to killing or show of force missions, she becomes overly excited and tends to act out.
[*] Due to lack of proper care and education during her childhood, she is not familiar with basic common sense or social norms/morals. However, she is a naturally quick thinker and sometimes surprises others by instinctively analyzing the possible scenarios that could happen around her.
[/list]

[b][ Personality ][/b]
[list]
[*] She has a complex about her difficult childhood and tries to hide her low self-esteem that resulted from it. These feelings led to her exaggerated fashion and behavior.
• As she got to know Crush, a bright and cheerful HARDWORKER, she usually changed her voice and manners to sound like a cooler and kinder girl than she ever was.
[*] At the end of the day, she is very depressed, and is consumed by all sorts of pessimistic delusions. The thoughts that dominate her mind then erupt into outbursts of violence and even homicidal urges when she is exposed to violent situations.
[*]  In order to soothe her negative thoughts she chose to 'read a storybook or write a storybook of her own'. Paper thought that was a nice thing to do, but it was probably because he hadn't yet read the gory fairy tale she'd written, filled with -blood and guts-.
[/list]

[b][ Relationships ][/b]
[list]
[*] She is terribly fond of Paper, whom she met while wandering the streets when she was about 15 years old . She seems to admire his personality, which is the exact opposite of her: thoughtful, knowledgeable, and calm.
[*] She tends to argue a lot with Hand, who brought her to the Gray Crows. "She's rude, ignorant, and often eccentric," Hand starts by telling her off, and Heavy would usually meekly agree, but sometimes she would explode and try to have a fistfight.
[*] She is waiting for the day to have a go at Hollowpoint, who tried to sneak into Paper and Heavy's scouting area, but he managed to slip away from Paper despite being discovered. Dressed in a primary-colored suit and gold jewelry, it seemed that he'd be spotted in no time, but her frustration grew when she wasn't able to find him. 
[/list]

[b][ Physical Attributes ][/b]
[list]
[*]  Born to Ukrainian parents, she has typical Slavic physical features.
• White skin, silver hair, and light blue eyes.
[*] Her right eye, which was injured as a child, has been replaced with a prosthetic eye that is a different color than her original eye, and she has an elongated scar around it.  
[*] Her hairstyle, which is multi-colored and finished in a dread-lock style is noticeable.
[*] She has a unique style of short, tight-fitting leather top and bottoms, with an over-sized jumper.
[*] About 10  handguns are attached to the inside of her suspiciously puffy jumpers.  
[/list]

[b][ Character Object ][/b]
[list]
[*] Bloody Children's Storybook
[*] Shows her inner spirit, brutally twisted, yet innocent.
[*] Blind Fake-eye
[*] A wounded psyche that can't look straight at the scars of the past.
[/list]

[b][ Habits ][/b]
[list]
[*] She has a habit of writing in her diary every night before bed.
• She tries to control her uncontrollable emotions as much as possible by writing about them in the diary.
[/list]

[b][ Hobbies ][/b]
[list]
[*] Stealing Stuff
[*] Drinking liqour at a bar and putting them on her tab
[*] Writing in her old diary every day
[/list]

notes.title: [Season 2] Person Information – Gray Paper
notes.content:
[h3]Person Information – Gray Paper[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/2a1ff993001bd6783bfe5b914adc863123b85d77.png[/img]

[b][ Character Introduction ][/b]
[list]
[*] Code Name:  Gray Paper (Affiliation: A.B. Gray Crows)
[*] Role within the organization: A.B. Intelligence/negotiation experts of the organization
[*] はやと(隼人, Hayato) [ hawk ]
[/list]
Also called the 'Newspaperman'. A.B. He is the one of the few people in the organization that Gray Hand trusts. Paper is very smart and hardworking, there's a rumor that he is one of the few people who gets praised by Hand for his work.

A pure-blood Japanese, his maternal grandfather was the boss of a huge yakuza organization in Japan. When Paper was 16 years old, his family's family was decimated in a war between yakuza gangs , and they had fled to a country in Eastern Europe , narrowly avoiding being killed by the other gang.

His life became miserable in an instant, and he started reading every newspaper he could find on the street. As his wealthy and untouched background disappeared overnight, so Paper tried to devise his own survival strategy, by coveting common sense and knowledge. He was also seen sitting in the public library in District 13, reading every book in the world. It is also great fun to watch the look on the librarian's face when Paper shows up at the library, because the librarian doesn't like that Paper always checks out books without paying, and then returns them late.

After his life was turned upside down, he wandered the streets for several years, supporting himself with odd jobs and begging. He than met and befriended Gray Heavy, but in the end he went to Gray Hand and became a member of A.B. organization.

In A.B., he was tasked with espionage and assassination missons. His sword skills, honed during his time in the Yakuza, allowed him to take out targets silently without making a sound. He also has a keen eye for political and social phenomena and is well versed in the written and spoken languages, which allowed him to successfully carry out important tasks such as negotiations and handling confidential information.

[b][ Position ][/b]

 - Striker
[list]
[*] His memories of living as a Yakuza at a young age have given him enough mettle that allows him to approach his targets regardless of the threat of various weapons.
[*] The big-hearted HARDWORKER Crush gaves him a customized gun, but he prefers to run like the wind with his katana and slash his way through.
[/list]

[b][ Specs  ][/b]
[list]
[*] Age : 23
[*] Height : 183 cm
[*] Weight :  80 kg
[*] Physique : He has a typical Northeast Asian appearance, with dark hair and dark eyes. His lean, toned body is covered in irezumi tattoos of all sorts of menacing shapes.
[*] Trained Sport : Traditional Japanese Swordmanship
[*] Rival : Mr. Hollowpoint
[*] Buddy : Gray Heavy 
[*] Likes : Newspapers, books, old clothes, and the musty smell of a closed subway station
[*] Dislikes : Hot weather, Angry voice of Gray Heavy
[/list]

[b][ Character Attributes ][/b]

[i]"I at least... I don't live as a beast, ignorant of god's will and grace." [/i]
[list]
[*] He usually sits around in closed subway stations, where he reads newspapers or books almost all day.  
[*]  Even though he is in A.B. and receives assistance for living, he scavenges through trash cans for food and clothing in okay condition. People around him are wondering if he's gotten into undercover work or if it's just part of his lifestyle.
[*] He likes to wear large coats and overcoats. If he happens to see a logo of a luxury brand while picking up discarded clothes, he is very happy even though he knows that it is a knockoff. 
[*] He has a good reputation within the organization for being quiet and diligent in his work. He has above-average common sense in a wide range of areas and is considered a jack-of-all-trades who has self-taught Russian and English to himself.

[/list]

[b][ Personality ][/b]
[list]
[*] As a young man, he was the prototypical member of a Yakuza family. Even as a teenager, he was living a life of violence and debauchery, backed by his family background and organization. 
[*] But when his organization and family fell, his survival instinct forced him to learn humility. He began to seek out books and newspapers to gain the knowledge he needed to live in this world.
[*] He's very quiet and doesn't change his facial expressions much, so no one around him really knows his past. But they make guesses on the irezumi Yakuza tattoos that cover his body.
[/list]

[b][ Relationships ][/b]
[list]
[*] He considers Heavy, whom he met when he fled to Eastern Europe and was taken in by his maternal uncle, his first true companion and comrade. After meeting her, who was younger than him and had been exposed to even more desperate circumstances, Paper gradually came to live as her protector. As their days together grow longer, Paper sees Heavy becoming increasingly dependent on him, and a paternal feeling he has never experienced before is beginning to grow on him.
[*] Since joining A.B., he's had many conversations with HARDWORKER Grasper who came to share the organization's various policies. To be exact, it was mostly just Grasper talking by himself. In the meantime, Paper is interested in the stories about the heads of organizations like HARDWORKER Zero that is slipped by Grasper's chatter.
[*] He once had a physical altercation with Mr.  Hollowpoint, an agent of A.S. Masters,  who was spying on him. For the first time in his life, Paper was confronted with a  conflict with an organization other than A.B., and he was perplexed. When Heavy learns of the conflict between Paper and Hollowpoint, she went on a rampage, and he realized that he needs to take out Hollowpoint and the forces behind it quickly, if only for Heavy's safety.
[/list]

[b][ Physical Attributes ][/b]
[list]
[*] He has a distinctive appearance of a typical Northeast Asians, especially those of Japanese (mainland) descent.
• Black hair and eyes, with a somewhat sharp eye line.
[*] His sharp features are obscured by his unkempt, bushy hair.  
[*] He is tall and well-built, with a lean, muscular body.
[*] Except for the top of his neck and the tips of his limbs, much of his body is covered in Irezumi tattoos of the Japanese Yakuza.
• Perhaps to hide his past as a member of a Yakuza family, he wraps himself in long-sleeved clothing, such as long coats and windbreakers, even in hot summer weather.
[*]  He wears an old long coat he picked up off the street on his way to join A.B. and enjoys wearing it every day. The brand tag on the lining of the coat bore the logo of an Italian luxury brand in crude print quality, but it was crude enough to give it away as a fake.
• But Paper didn't pay attention to the brand, saying it fit well and was easy to move around in, so he started coveting it as his number one treasure.
[*] He often tears out certain sections of the newspaper while reading. And he glued torn newspapers all over his precious long coat. Soon his coat was covered entirely in newspaper, and the pieces were being replaced and pasted over with new ones from time to time.
• The newspaper articles taped to the coat are usually about corrupt politicians and businessmen, or protests by labor unions. Within days, the person mentioned in the article is assassinated, and the some discussions linked to these people or organizations would go through quickly. 
[*] Paper's knowledge and neatness made him well-liked at the Crows, and he was nicknamed the "News Paper Man" after his fashion for wearing a coat that looked like it was made of newspaper. 
[/list]

[b][ Character Object ][/b]
[list]
[*] Encyclopedia
- Aside from newspapers, it's the book he spent the most time reading. Aside from the illegal information necessary for the life of a yakuza, Paper had little opportunity to develop a real worldly sense of common sense. As a result, he's always curious about new areas of knowledge he didn't know about, so he's been poring over the pages of encyclopedias.
[/list]

[b][ Habits ][/b]
[list]
[*] He has a habit of coughing before speaking.
• He's a man of few words, so when he does speak, he often coughs to clear his throat.
• So when Paper's thick, engaging voice makes a 'hmmm' sound, his coworkers naturally turn to look at him.
[/list]

[b][ Hobbies  ][/b]
[list]
[*] Reading books and newspaper articles
[*] Rewriting a book or newspaper article he doesn't like
• Paper's brow would frown when he reads something that has obviously ulterior motives. On the paper it's printed on, he'll furiously strike through it, tearing it up and rewriting it to his heart's content.
[*] Napping with his face covered by a newspaper or book
• His preferred resting spot is inside a closed subway station, but sometimes he'll find a spot in a crowded plaza or shopping alley and lay down. But when he goes outside, he peeks through the gap between the book and his face to see what's up. 
[/list]

notes.title: [Season 2] Person Information – Gray Hand
notes.content:
[h3]Person Information – Gray Hand[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/e62f03868a494614927b64a1c103765141602f9b.png[/img]

[b][ Character Introduction ][/b]
[list]
[*] Code Name:  Gray Hand (Affiliation: A.B. Gray Crows)
[*] Role within the organization:  Real head of Gray Crows 
[*] Real name: Руслан Руслан (Ruslan) [Like a lion] , Japanese name ルスラン
[/list]
A young man in his 20s, but he is the spiritual pillar for the Crows in Europe. He keeps his identity a secret from the public, and shortly after A.B. organization was founded, he was made the de facto leader of the Crows. 

Hand was born to a mixed-race family with a Japanese father and Russian mother. He grew up in Japan as a child, and has been wandering around Russia and Eastern European countries since his teen age years. Due to his thin build and mixed race appearance, he has faced racism and bullying in both Japan and Russia.

As he became an adult, he developed a strong concern for the poor and the alienated and consistently advocated an ideology of equality and hope on the Internet. He collected tons of data on the political/business and military/police systems of various countries with his excellent hacking skills, which he used to call for a more ideal world. The nickname he used as an Internet polemicist, 'The Visible Hand' [active moderator], was called the 'Hand' by many low-income people, and he gained idol-like support.

But after sitting down with Zero to discuss the formation of the coalition and the grand plans for the future, he was stance has turned over 180 degrees, as if he became a different person. No longer did he call for justice and fairness with a warm heart. For more than a year now, he has been working with terrifying intensity to create the weapons and equipment needed for a fighting organization. At night, he walks around in a bizarre mask and an assortment of weapons, ruthlessly terrorizing anyone who doesn't fit into A.B.'s idealized world.


[b][ Position ][/b]

 - Disruptor 
[list]
[*] After hacking into the classified information of military contractors and learning the key manufacturing processes, Hand uses these information to create and utilize a variety of specialized weapons. Hand's hobbies include throwing flash grenades to wreak havoc in an area or using personal time bombs. He also has a sickening hobby where he takes pleasure in watching his targets freak out at the sight of a ticking time bomb attached to their bodies.
[*] One of his strategic weapons is white phosphorus ammunition, which has been modified to reduce its power and make it easier to handle. He predicts the enemy's path of travel and restricts their movement with the flame zone of the white phosphorus ammunition. While some have braved the burning zone, the price of ignoring the flaming white phosphorus at room temperature only led to incapacitation.
[/list]

[b][ Specs ][/b]
[list]
[*] Age :  23
[*] Height : 176cm
[*] Weight :  75kg
[*] Physique :  Lean and thin
[*] Trained Sport : None
[*] Rival : Ms. One 
[*] Buddy : HARDWORKER Crush
[*] Likes : Computer programming, weapons/equipment development, mechanical materials such as carbon/metal, etc.
[*] Dislikes : Unfounded Justice and principles, stupidity, inefficient iteration/effort 
[/list]

[b][ Character Attributes ][/b]

[i]"I...I want you to try this new g...gun I made for you. Everything the megacorps make is g...ga...garbage!"[/i]
[list]
[*] A bomber, that hides his face by a mask and hood and commits acts of terror with his bombs. People, including the media, call him B.I.N. (the Bomber In the Night). It's not known what drove Hand to this behavior, but what's even more bizarre is that his current appearance was created in just over a year. 
[*] He was placed in an incubator as soon as he was born. Born sickly, his parents gave him the name 'Ruslan' in hopes that he would grow up to be healthy. Despite this desperate hope, Hand's slow physical growth only led to his childhood being looked down upon and bullied by those around him. 
[*] Since becoming the leader of the Gray Crows, he has been building the weapons and information/communications infrastructure necessary for the organization's missions. The organization gains vital intelligence from Hand's CCTV and eavesdropping equipment, and each member is outfitted with a customized weapon that suits them.
[/list]

[b][ Personality ][/b]
[list]
[*] A man of few words, he's hard to get to know and usually wears a special carbon fiber mask and a hooded poncho made of flame-resistant material.
[*] On the rare occasions when the words do come out of his mouth, he is not good with words which makes it quite frustrating for those trying to have a conversation with him. His conversations are also centered around the weapons and machines he's researching. Rumor has it that those who remember Hand's breadth and depth of knowledge and brilliant writings that once set the Internet ablaze were shocked to meet him in person.
[*] He is generally not interested in other people, but when he gets interested in someone, he obsessively observes and analyzes them. He is often seen watching the person he is interested in and smiling crookedly.
[*] When he's not working, he can be found immersed in comic books and anime. Paper once walked in on Hand's rest day and complained, "All he watches are cartoons about little girls with guns. 
[/list]

[b][ Relationships ][/b]
[list]
[*] After his talk with Zero since the formation of A.B., Hand's personality has changed dramatically. Originally, he was a member of the Crows, criticizing the absurdity of social structures and advocating for welfare to bring harmony between classes, mainly through the Internet. He would also sponsor young children who had lost their parents and were in need. But after becoming the second head of the Gray Crows, he began to transform into an extremist terrorist, spearheading A.B.'s destructive and radical agenda.
[*] HARDWORKER Crush is one of the few people around Hand that he recognizes as a technician. He feels it is hard to get used to her cheerful, sociable voice and her behavior, such as barging into his workspace, but when the topic of conversation turns to mechanical equipment, he's seems quite pleased even through his mask. In his conversation with Crush, Hand sometimes even forgets when to breathe, and his excitement is evident in his spittle splattering talks. 
[*] Ever since Ms. Twin started working undercover at the local burger joint, he's been there every day with HARDWORKER Grasper. Feeling uncomfortable with the two men staring at her with strange looks in their eyes, Twins give Hand and Grasper a hard time.
[*] In a construction site frozen in time with no owner, Hand spots Ms. One. He didn't like the fact that the members of A.S., who were against the A.B., dared to tread on his turf. She was a formidable fighter, but he managed to mortally wound her and send her home. But knowing she was still alive, Hand smiled with excitement, and began to scribble notes about One in his log book. 
[/list]

[b][ Physical Attributes ][/b]
[list]
[*] He is a young man with the appearance of a mixture of mainland Japanese and Slavic Russian. He has deep eye sockets, a strong and tall nose, black hair and eyes, and a piercing eye-line, so it's easy to tell at first glance that he is a half-blooded person of East and West.   
[*] Hand is quite thin, a reflection of his sickly childhood and bullying-ridden adolescence.   
[*] He wears many layers of clothing to conceal his appearance. He's especially fond of wearing hooded ponchos and baggy pants to make it hard to tell his size.
[*] To protect his body from impact and poisons while still covering the face, he wears a gas mask and respirator specially made from carbon fiber.
[*] He also wears force-enhancing mechanical gloves to overcome his lack of physical prowess. The fingertips of the gloves have claw-like metal finish that can inflict severe wounds. 
[*] When not on missions, he wears a tattered and worn T-shirt, jean jacket, or maintenance suits.   
[*] He doesn't care much about his appearance, other than his wavy hair. When his hair gets to the point where it's quite long, he will go get a curly hair perm done without anyone noticing it. 
[/list]

[b][ Character Object ][/b]
[list]
[*] Torches and rising smoke 
- Torch : symbolizes the charm that draws people to follow him, as he was once a leader on the Internet and is now the leader of the Gray Crows.
- Smoke : expresses his past and present, always hiding his true self and acting behind a mask.
[/list]

[b][ Habits ][/b]
[list]
[*] He has poor vision, so he often rubs his eyes and squints them.
[*] When talking to someone, he changes the color of the ambient light attached to the special mask from time to time. 
[/list]

[b][ Hobbies ][/b]
[list]
[*] Watching anime and collecting figurines
[*] Create observation reports and databases about the surrounding people
[*] Crafting/Modifying Personal Weapons and Defense Gear
[/list]

notes.title: [Dev Notes] Part-8: GTT Feedback - Chapter 3. Firearms System Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/fff6903e454505d21901dc55d12f1d8e23e961db.png[/img]


[h5][ Intro ] [/h5]

Hello, everyone. I am Kwon Dae Ho, the executive producer of Black Stigma. 

Since we already introduced ‘shooting balancing’ last time, now it’s a time to continue with sharing about the direction on how we will organize the firearms system. 

In the Global Testing Tour held during fall of last year, there were many concerns and requests for improvements regarding the firearms system. Therefore, will we explain what the problem was and what kind of system we will have in place to deal with it. 


[hr][/hr]
[h5][ Firearms placement issues during the Global Testing Tour ] [/h5]

The problems with the firearms themselves which some of you pointed out during the Global Testing Tour were as follows. 

[b]ⅰ. [u]The hierarchy of firearms exists, and the utility varies depending on the class.[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/ffb459ab3b0d8516ecd1775bc6f8f47079093394.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]In other words, shooting efficiency is not a matter of individual shooting skills. There is a possibility that it may be determined by factors other than skills such as paying money. 
[/list]
[b]ⅱ. [u]It seems like handguns are mainly used in this worldview, but the diversity of firearms is low.[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/076864aa3cf4fcb148da0ce429b3ebbdde1d6d4b.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Compared to other shooting games that from pistols to large heavy weapons are appeared, the difference in the usage mechanism or presentation of each gun is not significant. 
[/list]
To sum up, we have heard the opinions saying that the whole firearms settings should have some degree of fairness along with distinctive individuality which should be more clearly apparent. 

Our idea of worldview which pistols are the main firearm will not be changed, but we will try to produce a clearer difference in individuality. To achieve that, we’ve decided to [u](1) establish a firearms customization system[/u] and [u](2) introduce more diverse types of weapons.[/u] 


[hr][/hr]
[h5][color=lightgreen][ Introduction to the firearms customizing system ] [/color][/h5]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/073c3b68750fcee040e77dc0ead73824ccf5309b.gif[/img]

[color=orange][b]1) [u]Way to customize firearms[/u][/b][/color]

As you know, firearms modification (customization) is a culture widely seen among gun enthusiasts. That is what we would like to introduce in black stigma as well. 

The gun customization system is being developed in two ways: 
[list]
    [b]A. [u]You can improve your gun’s abilities or decorate it through firearms customization.[/u][/b]

Each customizing accessory has its own unique appearance to be attached to firearms. 
Also, some accessories can change specific capabilities of a gun depending on the type. 
In contrast, there are also types of accessories that simply build up a gun's embellishment without changing its capabilities. 

    [b]B. [u]Sacrificing control power to receive gun abilities effects in return.[/u][/b]

Depending on customization, some of the gun's abilities may be improved. However, for this to happen, the character using the gun must have more control power.
Therefore, players must secure maximum control power and research the customizing combination that best suits them under the limitation.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/91c0de0dabcf38a3f489db1a3351d25f6122969e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/8be4a0655305db10878bcc67426e503d576708b2.gif[/img]
[i]▲ A laser sight with more bullets in a magazine which is easier to aim is applied, but the character's control power is insufficient, so the accuracy drops. [/i]

★ In general, if the character's control power level doesn’t meet the gun's requirement, it will be not allowed to equip. But now we are considering about a rule that would allow it to be equipped despite a penalty level that would make normal use impossible. 



[color=orange][b]2) [u]Introduction to the modified components of firearms[/u][/b][/color]

The components of a firearm are divided into the following parts: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/cf23d33a5081f3c87ae107da755044f8c3dbc09f.png[/img]
[list]
    [b]A. [u]Basic Attachments (Main Parts)[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/12bc0158050ed41606828a8fdfa66650b6e9c543.png[/img]

        • In order to use this type of firearm, these attachments must be surely designated. 

        • It is divided into frame, slide, and magazine. 

        - Depending on the gun model, there may be parts that do not exist. 
        [i]ex. Slide doesn’t exist in Revolver style. [/i]

        • The basic attachments have various appearances/colors as well as differences in gun performance. 

        - Frame: You can change the firing method, such as burst/repeating/bust shot, etc. 
        - Slide: (No functional changes are planned for arrangement) 
        - Magazine: Slightly increases magazine capacity. (The number of additional bullets is approximately 10%) 


    [b]B. [u]Attachments[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/79ee253874b172144c00a65160da8eb95ed05623.png[/img]

        • Although this is not a mandatory part of a gun, it can upgrade a gun's abilities when being attached.

        • It is divided into muzzle attachments and optical equipment. 

        - Only one muzzle attachment is allowed to be attached to one gun model. Optical equipment is allowed to be attacthed to a gun multiply if the attachment positions are different. 

        • Muzzle attachments improve gun recoil or aiming accuracy. Optical equipment provides great convenience in aimed shooting. (Actual impact point shown) 


    [b]C. [u]Decoration Accessories[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/39c940089575bcfd13198bb8013fb490c9590239.png[/img]

        • This is an element that can decorate the appearance of a gun but does not directly increase the performance of the gun. 

        • It is divided into charms and stickers. 

        - Two or more charms and stickers can be mixed and applied to one gun model. 

        • Some charm items slightly increase the user's control power. 
[/list]


[h5][color=lightgreen][ Elements arrangement diversifying shooting experience addional to firearms ] [/color][/h5]

[color=orange][b]3) [u]Introduction of warhead replacement function[/u][/b][/color]

Another improvement is that you can now is that choose from a variety of warheads to equip.

Each warhead has two major values: (1) armor destruction ability and (2) bare body killing ability. This system was also present in the previous test version, but each gun had a fixed warhead. 

This time, you will need to find out how to choose a warhead based on your opponent's character or tactics. If a character with thick armor often plays in the enemy camp, a warhead that is good at destroying armor or penetrating armor will be advantageous. Otherwise, you should choose a warhead that can inflict more damage to the bare body.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/d7be9b5100663371542457602fcb1dad8580d6ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/b9458d07f296ec549713e0672ef21c773a5d571f.png[/img]


[color=orange][b]4) [u]Added pistols and skills to provide unique shooting styles[/u][/b][/color]

While maintaining the rule of using only handguns, various gun concepts commonly found in other shooting games are also applied to Black Stigma. 

There are three main types of new concept guns that have been implemented up until this moment. 
[list]
    [*]Magnum Revolver: Uses high-power bullets to inflict devastating damage at one point. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/25550adfc4a3114d19e52246618d13879eb1bc32.png[/img]
    [*]Large-diameter double barrel: Demonstrates lethal power in close combat using shotgun shells 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/1dfcb19b50427bb14fc4d9e7f7141dd20ee5e83f.png[/img]
    [*]High-capacity target pistol: Easy control and large-capacity ammunition magazine provides the fun of continuous shooting 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/90cfd035a924f09edc4ae674125c7763ceb96e3f.png[/img]
[/list]
Additionally, new mechanical skills are developed to provide the feeling of ‘long-range sniping’. 
[list]
    [*]A new character who uses archery is now being prepared, and the character will be able to use long-range sniping skills by shooting a bow. 
    [*]In addition, as a hero shooting genre, we plan to amplifly the enjoyment of shooting by diversifying more skills. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/30ce029406ac6abb19bb14ccd97f25baa0a69184.png[/img]
[i]▲ Like"Hawkeye", a character from Marvel who has a general shooting/carpet ability, but he   also has the most outstanding skill with a setting of archery. [/i]


[hr][/hr]
[h5][ Conclusion ] [/h5]

While maintaining the worldview of a secret dark killer in society, it won't let you miss out any joy you've ever experienced before in the other shooter games. As a result, Black Stigma will try to provide a variety of shooting experiences in different angles.  

The firearms system reformation which I’ve mentioned above will be ready right away, so see you in the next test service. 

Thank you.



[b]Best Regards, 
Producer Kwon Dae ho [/b]
