notes.title: [Season.2] Person Information - Hardworker Crush
notes.content:
[h3]Person Information – Hardworker Crush[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/a01a8ccce7620c3659049b1aaa04ec8cf8798249.png[/img]

[b][Character Introduction][/b]
[list]
[*] Codename: Hardworker Crush (‘Crush’) (Affiliation: A.B. HARDWORKERS)
[*] Role within the organization: A weapons maker/manager of the A.B. Organization
[*] Real name: lǐ wèi (李伟) [Great] 
[/list]
Someone Gray Hand brought into the organization at some point and told them that she is a friend. No one really knows much about Hardworker Crush's past. She's a mysterious character, but because she tries so hard to live her life to the fullest, those around her don't ask much about her past.

She fled to Europe to escape the riots in her hometown and was brought to A.S. to study firearms. She was given the task of building various firearms from their drawings in Parabellum's workshop. She later followed Hand to A.B., where she is now responsible for both the design and production of weapons in a more free atmosphere. 


[b][Position][/b]

- Striker
[list]
[*] Possessing both fine marksmanship and ruthless striking combat abilities, she is often seen charging into the field with a team of tough male operatives.
[*] Her weapons include a large pipe wrench and a demolition axe, and she wears body armor and a motorcycle helmet to show off her skills in hand-to-hand combat. 
[/list]

[b][Specs][/b]
[list]
[*] Age: 27
[*] Height: 176cm
[*] Weight: 67kg (Up to 93kg, with combat gear)
[*] Physique: Tall and lean, with a muscular build built from rough activities.
[*] Sport: None
[*] Rival: None
[*] Buddy: Gray Hand (Hand)
[*] Likes: Junk, scraps, construction equipment, junkyards, and smell of sweat
[*] Dislikes: Inflexible rules and laws. 
[/list]

[b][Character Attributes][/b]

[i]"Was that so hard and scary to do? Hahahaha! Let's do it together!"[/i]
[list]
[*] She treats people with a breezy personality, which is reflected in her habit of laughing out loud. Her habit of laughing brightly and loudly, maybe often too much, makes people around her like her.
[*] 'Wei' means 'Great'. It is a fitting name for Crush, who loves change. Her mother gave her the name when she was growing up in China.
[*] She spends her days working on construction sites and her nights crafting weapons for her team members. Her daily routine of manual labor made her physically stronger than most men.
[*] Along with Gray Hand, she is in charge of making equipment within the A.B. organization. 
[/list]

[b][Personality][/b]
[list]
[*] She likes to get carried away in discussions about trivial things. She prefers conversations with straightforward answers to complicated ones.
[*] She has a strong dislike of frustration and finds unnecessary arguments with others annoying. Likes to be honest, no matter what the topic. 
[/list]

[b][Relationships][/b]
[list]
[*] Likes Zero's unorthodox fighting style.
[*] Has some past ties with Ms. Twin but no one else in the organization knows the full story between them.
[*] She is close to Gray Hand, who has similar interests to her own. They debate daily about whose ideas and inventions are better and often end up fighting over it.  
[/list]

[b][Physical Attributes][/b]
[list]
[*] Her black hair and single-eyelid eyes seem to confirm the story that she came from China.
[*] Due to her long years of working in construction, she has bronze-colored skin from prolonged exposure to sunlight.
[*] In battle, she wears clothes with various bizarre and strange mechanical gadgets attached to them. Some of her gadgets are of her own design, while others she has stolen from Hand's workbench. 
[/list]

[b][Character Object][/b]
[list]
[*] Tuned Motorcycle
- The means of transportation that reflects her fiery personality, it has all sorts of modifications to make it roar and produce more power.
- It's usually on display at the A.B. organization's compound, and she takes great pride in her bike. 
[/list]

[b][Habits][/b]
[list]
[*] She has a habit of observing the smallest details. 
- Depending on the flow of her thoughts, even a rock on the side of the road can become the object of her attention. Anything that catches her eye, she scrutinizes, touches, and even tries to break it to see a cross-section. 
[/list]

[b][Hobbies][/b]
[list]
[*] Picking up scrap metal lying around the construction site, tinkering and experimenting
[*] Building and discussing gear with Gray Hand
[*] Modifying and driving the bike
- She has a large bike that she just picked up new, and it's been a while since she's brought it back to the base for modifications. Other members of the organization often use it for last-minute needs when she's not around, and it's almost become a communal bike. 
[/list]

notes.title: [Season.2] Person Information - Hardworker Grasper
notes.content:
[h3]Person Information – Hardworker Grasper[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/749608b42558fe865c5461e26121511cfb576b28.png[/img]

[b][Character Introduction][/b]
[list]
[*] Codename: Hardworker Grasper (‘Grasper’) (Affiliation: A.B. HARDWORKERS)
[*] Role within the organization: A spy and guide for the A.B. organization
[*] Real name: Adonis [ Young Hunter ]
[/list]
Brought into the A.B. organization by Hardworker Zero, he is a muscular young man with an agile body. After signing a secret contract with Zero, he became his shadow, taking care of many of the annoying things that happen around him. He usually recruits new talent or escorts VIPs from outside the organization to secret locations underground.

Having grown up in an orphanage he was severely bullied during his childhood, but his first love in his adolescence saved his life. He learned to control his own emotions and began playing football in Ireland, but his days on the field were cut short when he was seriously injured in an attack by thugs.

Zero appeared in front of him when his heart was broken again, and offered him to 'give up the old life, and live a new life as a member of the A.B. organization,' and Grasper followed him to join the A.B., leaving his whole life, his first love behind. 


[b][Position][/b]

- Infiltrator
[list]
[*] His experience as a football player in Ireland shows up in his missions, he prefers to quickly get into close-up melee battles or hit-and-run tactics.
[*]He has had no formal combat training, such as marksmanship or martial arts, but that doesn't seem to matter to him as he works his muscles every day. 
[/list]

[b][Specs][/b]
[list]
[*] Age: 28
[*] Height: 173cm
[*] Weight: 70kg
[*] Physique: A good-looking young man with a lean, muscular, athletic build
[*] Sport: Gaelic (Irish) football
[*] Rival: None, He does not think to be competing against anyone
[*] Buddy: Gray Paper (Paper)
[*] Likes: Collecting/maintaining tracksuits, looking at Zero gear
[*] Dislikes: Child abuse, cowardice
[/list]

[b][Character Attributes][/b]

[i]"I'm your guide into the underground. Come with me, there's no turning back."[/i]
[list]
[*] With looks reminiscent of a handsome boy from Greek mythology and a gentle smile that masks his true feelings, Grasper is a man who keeps his true intentions a secret.
[*] The name ‘Grasper’ was given to him by Zero, when he was questioning his true identity after leaving the orphanage. It's a name that fits his role at A.B. as a talent recruiter and VIP concierge.
[*] A former Gaelic (Irish) soccer player, he now works as a miner. He is the most knowledgeable person about the underground passageways that lead to A.B.'s bases.
[*] He loves to listen to music. Even when he works out, he doesn't forget to pack a wireless headset to listen to music.
[*] He tries to be polite, always using respectful words to strangers. However, you never know what he's really thinking. Sometimes, when he's angry, vulgar words may come out of his mouth. 
[/list]

[b][Personality][/b]
[list]
[*] While he generally gets along well with people, even those in his own organization have no idea what he's really thinking.
[*] His inner thoughts are completely different from what he shows on the outside, he has more than one characteristic, and is used to putting on an act to deceive others.
[*] In his childhood, he was bullied in an orphanage, which left him with a delicate and helpless personality. However, thanks to the advice of his first love, he has been wearing his own "personality mask" since adolescence. 
[/list]

[b][Relationships][/b]
[list]
[*] He envies Gray Paper, who knows a lot of knowledge and information and uses it freely.
[*] His first love, who influenced him a lot during his orphanage days when his personality started to become skewed, resembles Ms. Nano, which is why he is reluctant to face her.
[*] He has a complicated relationship with Hardworker Zero, and he has mixed feelings about Zero.
- One of them is that he wants to leave Zero and the organization and go back to his life before he was a member. Although things didn't work out as he had hoped, he still had a life in his late teens where he made memories with his first love and strived for a bright future.
- On the other side, he also wants to follow Zero's wish to forget about his past with his first love and focus on his current life as a member of the A.B. organization.
[*] Grasper and Zero have different ideas about each other.
- Grasper -> Zero: An absolute supporter, a father figure. He is grateful for the social recognition he received from Zero at a time when his future as a soccer player was destroyed. However, he also resents Zero for isolating him from the "outside world," including his first love.
- Zero -> Grasper: Zero sees Grasper as merely a tool for the organization's success. Zero has taken advantage of Grasper's physical and emotional wounds to use him as a puppet. However, there are times when he thinks of Grasper as an abandoned animal and shows signs of weakness. 
[/list]

[b][Physical Attributes][/b]
[list]
[*] He has the typical Celtic, Irish appearance, with red hair and freckles.
[*] He has a not-so-large frame and is well-developed, with toned muscles all over his body.
[*] He looks the youngest of all A.B.'s main members. 
[*] He is rarely seen in formal attire and has a relaxed fashion style. He rarely wears anything but training shorts, especially when he needs to use his physique. 
[/list]

[b][Character Object][/b]
[list]
[*] Wireless Headset
- It's one of his ways of keeping his mind off the sounds outside.
[*] The half-covered mask
- Hints at his duality, as he is not the same on the outside as he is on the inside. 
[/list]

[b][Habits][/b]
[list]
[*] Due to some past trauma, he exercises daily to keep the body strong and fit. 
[/list]

[b][Hobbies][/b]
[list]
[*] Working Out
[*] Shopping for workout clothes, headsets, and collecting exercise equipments
[*] Organizing the workout playlist of music 
[/list]

notes.title: [Season.2] Person Information - Hardworker Zero
notes.content:
[h3]Person Information – Hardworker Zero[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/fa3da36d410d81a32239400e4a2f79c32c2c5c8f.png[/img]

[b][Character Introduction][/b]
[list]
[*] Codename: Hardworker Zero (‘Zero’) (Affiliation: A.B. HARDWORKERS)
[*] Role within the organization: Second in command of the A.B. organization
[*] Real name: Виктор (Viktor) [ victor ] 
[/list]
A man in his late fifties, he has been with the HARDWORKERS the longest. He was originally a Master in A.S. for nearly 30 years, but under a secret pact with the second head of A.S. and mentor Mr. Anyone(Anyone), he joins the rest of the HARDWORKERS members in a new group the A.B..

He has led the core of A.S. the HARDWORKERS into Mr.Anyone's arms from the beginning at the A.S. to A.B.. Naturally, the A.S. leadership views Anyone and Zero as an eyesore, as they were directly responsible for the departure of the HARDWORKERS.

But for some reason, Zero himself has declared that he will not be involved in any disputes with the A.S.. As a result, despite several anti-A.S. missions in A.B., Zero has been absent from the scene. 


[b][Position][/b]

- Marksman
[list]
[*] Decades he spent as a killer has given Zero outstanding marksmanship skills. His experience with countless firearms and his sturdy muscles allow him to fire even the most powerful pistols with the largest bullets without flinching.
[*] In addition to marksmanship, he is also skilled in close-range combat with his special railgun that has been modified into a weapon. Enemies who manage to get past Zero's bullets are met with hits from his gauntlet-like reinforced railgun and dozens of nails from his railgun.
[/list]

[b][Specs][/b]
[list]
[*] Age: 57
[*] Height: 181cm
[*] Weight: 90kg
[*] Physique: Sturdy and heavy/ Wears thick gear
[*] Sport: boxing, weightlifting, judo, and various other sports
[*] Rival: Mr. Ten(Ten)
[*] Buddy: None
[*] Likes: Fighting, provoking, or arguing people
[*] Dislikes: anything that bores him, peace, calm, people who are not confident 
[/list]

[b][Character Attributes][/b]

[i]"You're thinking too much young man, isn't it easier to get rid of the ones that get in the way?"[/i]
[list]
[*] Despite his large size, he loves to grow cacti. He once thought about running a flower shop with his grown daughter, but it was an unrealistic fantasy.
[*] Perhaps because his real name is "Viktor," which means victor, he has always valued winning and success as the most important thing in life. This has made his life as a psychopathic hitman, devoid of morality and humanity, easy for him.
[*] He uses dazzling techniques and skillful maneuvers and has developed a powerful arsenal of weapons that only he can wield. Some of these weapons have high recoils and are unwieldy, and Gray Hand(Hand) has spent months researching and making them.
[/list]

[b][Personality][/b]
[list]
[*] He is an extreme realist and doesn't empathize well with others, and his focus on efficiency often leads to quick, but unethical, closure.
[*] Although he is thoughtful and cautious, he firmly believes that negotiation and compromise can eventually be overcome by overwhelming violence. These values have led him to be criticized for his frequent use of violence when he was a Master of A.S.
[*] While most people around him considered him to have a personality spectrum that made him addicted to violence, in reality, his behavior was merely a result of his view of all human beings as a means to an end. 
[/list]

[b][Relationships][/b]
[list]
[*] He has rescued Twin from a human trafficking ring in the past. As a result, he has maintained a friendly relationship with Twin.
[*] He is a secret supporter of the Hardworker Grasper, and spends a lot of time with him. He's even given Grasper several missions himself, which makes it seem to others that the two men have a close relationship. However, Zero's view of Grasper is a mixture of family-like affection and treating him like a tool.
[*] His biological daughter, Ms. Nano, resents him to no end. Not only did her father, her only blood relative, abandon her, but he also abandoned the A.S. organization she joined.
[*] He is a good match for field missions with Hardworker Crush, who fights in a reckless and fierce manner. 
[/list]

[b][Physical Attributes][/b]
[list]
[*] A Russian man with a hard-lined face and a thick beard
[*] He seems lean on the outside, but his body is covered in sturdy muscles honed by decades of construction work and assassination missions.
[*] He wears an assortment of equipment that appears to be various tools but has been modified for combat.
- He wears a durable and powerful nailgun that has been modified to fire nails like a gauntlet
- Wears a special welding mask for protection and concealment
- And has steel armor pieces attached to his heart and limbs to withstand bullets and knives. 
[/list]

[b][Character Object][/b]
[list]
[*] Cactus
- This represents his menacing first impression, symbolizing the tough environment of his upbringing. It was also the first gift he received from his daughter. 
[/list]

[b][Habits][/b]
[list]
[*] He has a habit of touching his beard. He is very fond of the well-groomed beard. 
[/list]

[b][Hobbies][/b]
[list]
[*] Builds/modifies combat gear
[*] Various Sporting Experiences
[*] Especially enjoys ground-based martial arts like judo/jiu-jitsu sparring with Grasper
[/list]

notes.title: [Dev Notes] Part-7: GTT Feedback - Chapter 2. Shooting Balance Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/4a3342e996016f3b2705d8e3706b398d542b7c8f.png[/img]


[h5][ Intro ] [/h5]

Hello, Masters. I'm Kwon Dae Ho, the Executive Producer of Black Stigma.

In this developer's note, we want to talk about one of the most talked about VOC from the Global Testing Tour, the balance of the combat, or more precisely, the 'balance of shooting'.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/519079d522613a707fb0ed5af1471214c8c53853.png[/img]

As this is a PVP game, the balance of the combat is the most important and sensitive issue for our testers. We had to carefully consider the improvements before sharing our thoughts about this topic, because of this, we're only now tackling the topic of balance, despite it being the topic with the most complaints, to more carefully organize our improvements. 



[h5][ Issues on Shooting Balance found in Global Testing Tour ] [/h5]

At Black Stigma, we've tried to do various things to provide in our shooter games, and we'll continue to do so, but we wanted to make sure that the shooter at the center of the game was perfect for this test. However, in retrospect, we feel that we could not fulfill the needs of our testers during this test. 

We have located the three following reasons for our shortcomings. 

a. Headshots felt relatively anemic compared to other games.

b. Each master had little variations of characteristics on handling firearms.

c. Bullets felt less powerful and provided little tension in gunfights.

To address each of these issues, we're introducing the following four improvements. 



[h5][ Key Changes in Shooting Balance ] [/h5]

[b]1) [u]Headshot damage will be improved.[/u][/b]

Most shooter games will deal the most damage for headshots. Black Stigma also has the highest damage set to the head, but not as much as other games our users had experienced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/1e91820f7b984eb4516e9e7af843fcdbef22e942.gif[/img]
[i]< Weakest handgun shot of game A, Body(4 shots) while Head (2 Shots) so it had 2 times the damage >[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/9a413774b53e0bb672a350a9d2d793206606684e.gif[/img]
[i]< Weakest handgun shot of game B, Body(8 shots) while Head (2 Shots) so it had 4 times the damage > [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/1ade5e42851a690ca08c66199d371a2cc961dc43.gif[/img]
[i]< Weakest handgun shot of Black Stigma, Body(6 shots) while Head (4 Shots) so the shots feel different > [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/cd6719391d1d7b105b6fe3d2cb78894cf49d4528.png[/img]

In response, we're going to dramatically increase the damage of headshots to match the experience of headshots in other games. We're currently tuning our test builds with headshots that do about 3 times the damage of torso shots. We won't know the final number until we're done tuning, but it's likely to be around 300%, which is what we've seen in other games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/91c995d0b22d3c836bc4b64aa997c05924e0076b.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/b9dab9c9cfdf0929cc80eb9af84f0026aed8c300.gif[/img]
[i]< Shooting screenshot in the latest build of Black Stigma, You can observe the differences of headshot efficiency(before/after 300%) the weakest handgun(left)and the strongest handgun(right)>  [/i]

It will differ depending on the firepower of your firearms and the presence of head armor, we expect it to deliver more of the exhilarating headshot you've experienced in other games. 



[b]2) [u]You won't be able to use guns that have a higher Control Power number than you.[/u][/b]

In this testing, we gave each Master a different value of Control Power to differentiate their shooting style. We wanted to showcase the individual characteristics of each Master's fighting style, whether it be in a suppression/infiltration role or an all-out assault/protection role, depending on their Control Power.

However, we've seen masters with low control power equip heavy firearms and play in one shooting style at the expense of accuracy penalties. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/3ae7435d0ae521817c4ed65f8951a1eb674667a9.png[/img]
[i]< Except for 'Twin' that doesn't have the right-click aiming system, high Control Power guns such as LW Eagel L6 or Hollow Ten was included in the high preference weapons top 3 for all Masters. > [/i]

We felt that this didn't fully capitalize on Black Stigma's identity as a 'hero shooter' genre, and we wanted to strengthen the Control Power constraints.

You'll no longer be able to choose a gun with a higher Control Power than your Master. We believe this adjustment will allow players to maintain their shooting style, but instead of having a similar shooting experience with different characters, players will experience a distinctly different style of shooting action based on their Control Power.
This decision will also be reflected in the gun customization we'll be introducing in the future, giving players the freedom to customize their guns to fit their style of play. 



[b]3) [u]The bigger the character, the higher the Control Power.[/u][/b]

As the title suggests, we want to give larger characters higher Control Power and smaller characters lower Control Power. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/2a071a42c79fe5197be946ea440953ff4a9e0db9.png[/img]

These measures were added as part of our efforts to increase the rate of gunfights. Because larger characters have relatively large hit boxes, so they have a disadvantage in a regular gunfight. We implemented this as a balancing measure to compensate for that. 



[b]4) [u]The damage absorption rate of armor will be decreased.[/u][/b]

From a 'familiarity' standpoint with other games, there was something else we missed in this test besides headshots. The armor effects on hits. We did some comparative analysis with other games to see if Black Stigma's armor effects were too strong. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/e93ccf97f36644f442e82cdce99d0f06280ec9cf.png[/img]

In conclusion, we decided that the armor effectiveness in the test version was a bit high compared to other games, and we decided to reduce it. The reduction is generally 2/3 of what it used to be, so that it feels more in line with armor effectiveness in other games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/0f15eb88aedfb31ee0cb1063ab92b19e6b6ac7e1.png[/img]



[h5][ Expected results of Improved Shooting Balance ] [/h5]

We prepared these improvements to the shooting system to make gunfights feel more intense, but also to make Black Stigma feel more friendly to a wider audience.

In our next test version, we'll showcase Black Stigma as a shooter that's easier for you to get into.

Also, as part of the shooting rebalance, Active Skills will be impacted. We will be introducing specific changes to Active Skills in our next developer note, and we look forward to your continued interest and support. Thank you.



[b]Sincerely, Producer Kwon Dae Ho [/b]

notes.title: [Dev Notes] Part-6: GTT Feedback - Chapter 1. Creating a Dynamic Game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/eb26cec1ed1f2bf408f31c52f5eeab6216ef7133.png[/img]


[h5][ Intro ] [/h5]

Hello, Masters. I'm Kwon Dae Ho, the Executive Producer of Black Stigma.

We have previously addressed the improvements we were planning to make based on the feedback we received during the Global Testing Tour that was held from October to December.

We would first like to share the progress report on the improvements we are making based on the feedback that Black Stigma should be a more dynamic, fast-paced game. A total of 17.2% of players felt that the Masters' movement and speed of the game were slow.


[b]  ▼ Among the negative feedback we received during the Global Testing Tour [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/0c90e26288481eac72c026ba67bd0972fbb782c8.png[/img]

We have made great progress in our internal development to solve such issues and would like to share them through this Dev Note.



[h5][ Improvements in Movement Animation ] [/h5]

In the previous test version, most of the Masters had only one movement animation, which was an animated version of the tactical stance called "Center Axis Relock."

However, many players have pointed out that it looked awkward and rigid for the Masters to move around using the same animation.

In response, big changes to the standard movement animation were implemented to address this issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/5ad7b6af02ebcc7083bb13a4b31368b23fab53a2.gif[/img]
[i]<< We received feedback that players found the movement animation to be inflexible during the Global Testing Tour. >> [/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/655543009b412c4cad6e95b36abd14feaacdfb11.gif[/img]
[i]<< We aim to showcase action-packed, dynamic movement animation in the current version we are developing. >>[/i]
 

As you can see in the example above, even characters without Sprint abilities will be moving in a more unconfined manner when sped up through different means, such as Movement Speed Increase Boosters.



[h5][ Increased Base Movement Speed ] [/h5]

The Masters' actual movement speed was far from the fast-paced action we were aiming for. It is possible to momentarily increase the movement speed through Sprinting and Boosters, but we came to the conclusion that the general pace of the game should be faster.

We have taken into consideration the fast movement speed you've experienced in other shooting games and adjusted the base movement speed to match that of similar games.

Therefore, you will be able to experience an approximate 20% increase in all Masters' base movement speed in the next version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/24a242240d2676d3fa68e862913ed55377d127d9.gif[/img]
[i]<< Adjusted the base movement speed of Black Stigma from 5 m/s to 6 m/s >>[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/f849e7c17ae30892b773be4761e3a7d708a9a29f.png[/img]
[i]<< Other shooting games have a variety of movement speeds based on the weapon type, but the fastest base movement speed was 5.73 m/s >>[/i]


The faster movement speed will enable your Masters to appear more dynamic and should elevate the immersive experience. On top of that, it should provide faster and more frequent opportunities for combat. We believe that this change will create more action in the previously stale matches.



[h5][ Increased Speed for Attack Skill Animation ] [/h5]

We acknowledge that the rigidity of attack skills was another issue that caused the game to appear slower. We released a small patch to improve this issue during the Global Testing Tour, but the later versions will showcase details in skill animations that have undergone various changes.

We would like to give you two examples using Hand's E skill.

[b]- Animation Canceling System [/b]
: For each skill animation, you can now cancel the mid to late animation (≒Recovery frames) of the attacker and proceed with a different action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/2732071c1955851ba200cbdb10eecfb5404c9aca.gif[/img]
[i]<< Placed multiple openings for players to cancel the skill animation, allowing a fast-paced attack sequence >>[/i]


[b]- Changes Made to the Forced Camera Angle[/b]
: We have deleted and adjusted many of the forced camera angles for certain skills, which should provide players with a better sense of freedom and speed in controlling the Masters. 



[h5][ Outro ] [/h5]

We in the development team hope that the changes listed above will help Black Stigma provide quick, action-packed matches to the playerbase.

There are more improvements we plan to make based on the feedback we got through the Global Testing Tour, and we will be sharing the progress in the near future.

Thank you.



[b]Sincerely, Producer Kwon Dae Ho[/b]

notes.title: [Dev Notes] Part-5: Future development after the Global Testing Tour
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/3b36a7c861e3e9ca4e6ad2efaf27826221ee72fe.png[/img]

Hello, Masters. I'm Kwon Dae Ho, the Executive Producer of Black Stigma.

A total of 60 countries have participated in our Global Testing Tour, which was held in five regions from October 3rd to December 11th.

We would like to thank everyone who tested Black Stigma.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/23af4d8a766bf4eca68a0a9e67a140dc66c33a43.png[/img]
The compliments and encouragement we've received while showcasing this test version have been extremely helpful to the Black Stigma development team. The positive feedback on the unique features we were focusing on reassured us that the gameplay goal we had previously set was not in vain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/c779e0f9506dbd78bd8bdd8ee4989f9371ba5d70.png[/img]
We have also received sincere criticism and advice through the surveys and various channels. Those comments were a massive help in setting the next goal for Black Stigma.


[h4]<Major VoC - Feedback> [/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/d3b32f0ca1907d2cb2696ede3a6260c66d6b3d02.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892526/930b2f96a95565fa842efccb430979bfe4e69d12.png[/img]
We have decided to prioritize the feedback given to us by the testers and develop the game accordingly. The tasks we set from that point on are already in development or being planned. Among these tasks, we would like to share the improvements that we deem important.


[h5][b]#We will continue to balance out the combat. [/b][/h5]

We have failed to showcase a good balance of handgun shooting and active skills in combat. We especially related to the feedback regarding the heavy emphasis on active skills. Therefore, we are thinking about how we can restructure combat so that handgun shooting can play a bigger role. We are also improving the timing and hit or miss system so that melee action skills can be used intuitively.


[h5][b]#We will showcase dynamic action so that the characters feel more immersive. [/b][/h5]

Based on the testers' feedback, we are in the process of altering the characters' movements and skill animations in a more natural and speedy way. In addition, there is a yet-to-be revealed character with a dynamic set of movements that will feel unique and stylish.


[h5][b]#We will improve the tactical aspect and immersion of "Kill-them-all Mode" and showcase a new mode. [/b][/h5]

The current ""Kill-them-all Mode"" has received feedback as follows: ""Huge advantage to players who group up."" ""Gameplay is boring due to a lack of a capture point."" ""There are too few chances to come back into the game while at a disadvantage."" To escape the monotonous gameplay decided by numbers, we have changed Kill-them-all Mode to 3v3 during the test period. On top of the player-count change, we are also improving the mode by adding new game mechanics.

We are also planning to showcase a new 3v3v3 mode where players can enjoy a casual match with the gameplay and unique features of the killer-action genre.


[h5][b]#We will showcase a "variable attachment" handgun system that can incorporate the tastes of many players. [/b][/h5]

During this test, we showcased 4 different modifications for 16 different guns. However, these types of combinations did not result in a clear distinction. Therefore, we are developing a gun customization feature that can complement the different combat styles of the userbase. We hope this will allow users to combine different attachments to show off their own unique firearms.


[h5][b]#We will show you an improved version of the UI/UX and QoL features. [/b][/h5]

Our game lacked QoL features that are seen in other games. Additionally, it didn't give players enough opportunities to learn its mechanics. We are making big changes to help players understand and learn the system during the preparation stage and to help players receive information intuitively during combat. 


[h5][b]#We will review all the feedback given by testers around the world and continue sharing it through the Dev Notes. [/b][/h5]

Some issues were already improved upon, and we wanted to get feedback on them through a patch during the test period. However, the general gameplay does not improve through small changes in specific areas, so we wish to receive feedback once we finish the overall improvement and reveal a new testing period.

We will continue communicating with the testers by sharing the aspects that we have developed and the aspects we have not mentioned above through the Dev Notes.

 
We hope to bring more news soon.

Thank you.
 

Sincerely, Producer Kwon Dae Ho

Hello, this is BLACK STIGMA team. 


With the Global Testing Tour starting in October,  
BLACK STIGMA wants to grow together with streamers.  

For this purpose, we are launching the ‘Partner Streamer Program’. 


[h3][b]What is the Partner Streamer Program? [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] We envision our BLACK STIGMA game growing together with streamers who broadcast games on the Internet. 

[*] We promise to provide support, including special permissions, to streamers who partner with us to broadcast about BLACK STIGMA. 

[*] Streamers who have signed a partnership can broadcast using BLACK STIGMA as content, which differentiates them from other streamers, receive game support from the developer, and dominate issues faster than others. 

[*] If a partner streamer achieves a certain number of broadcasts and viewers, cash compensation of up to [b]1,000 USD[/b] will be paid based on performance at the end of the program period. 
[/list]


[h3][b]Program operation schedule [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Streamer application period 
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/e0bfa9ea8fc793caa8d0d6d3a0573e7ddbe84b8a.png[/img]
Please check the separate notice ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1277530/view/3680059005335830828]Steam News link[/url]) for detailed country placement by region. 
[/list]

[*] Streaming period
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/517acb2c3ce741eb6efa8bc676c412a5c3032c63.png[/img]
[/list]

[*] Performance and compensation confirmation period: DEC. 5th ~ DEC. 22th

[*] Performance-specific reward delivery period: Sending sequentially from DEC. 22th (completed within a maximum of 1 month) 
[/list]


[h3][b]Participation eligibility information [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] You must be active on the Twitch platform.

[*] Your channel must have at least 50 followers on Twitch. 

[*] Partner streamers must be of age under the laws of their country of origin.  
[list](Due to issues with game tier and receiving monetary rewards) [/list]

[*] You must have a Paypal account for performance-based monetary rewards.  
[list]
[*] You can become a partner even if you do not have a Paypal account, but you will not receive monetary compensation based on future performance achievements. 
[/list]
[/list]


[h3][b]Information on how to apply and joining process  [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Please fill out the streamer participation application form. 
[list]
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSetDCj3BpI6yk533x55SBbfOIPxFJLSLp5cfHGBj4kxfx23QA/viewform?usp=sf_link][u][b][h2]< Participation Form (Google Account required) > [/h2][/b][/u][/url]
[/list]
[*] We will review your application and notify you of whether you have been selected as a partner on the announcement date for each region. 

[*] Those selected as partners will be notified through a separate hotline channel before the start of service in each region. 
[/list]


[h3][b]Live Streaming Mission Guide  [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] When broadcasting on the Twitch platform, be sure to add the ‘BLACK STIGMA’ category in the broadcast information edit menu. 
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/6d1e6f63c3fa81da87416f84bde46e13b960d14d.png[/img]
[/list]

[*] Please check 'Branded Content'. 
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/be5492b32c376d5e984d92acc94ecd61e67d86da.png[/img]
[/list]

[*] Please broadcast your play at least 2 times and for at least 2 hours each time before settlement. 

[*] You must follow the policies of your partner streamer program between broadcasts. Partner streamer program policies will be announced on the dedicated Discord channel.
[/list] 


[h3][b]Partner Streamer Benefits and Rewards  [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] The following conveniences and benefits are provided to streamers selected as partners. 
[olist]
[*] We invite partner streamers to a dedicated Discord channel and provide a hotline with the developer.  

[*] Partner streamers can open custom game rooms during this Global Testing Tour. A custom game is not a random match, but rather a method in which only people invited by the host gather together and form teams and spectators of their choice.  

[*] For smooth testing, necessary game goods will be provided upon request. 

[*] Cash rewards are paid based on the maximum number of viewers achieved for each broadcast episode. 
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/95371f41ce418cbd3581de2d563a7cd4888c1c0b.png[/img]
[/list]
[list]
[*] Those who broadcast BLACK STIGMA material for the minimum number of broadcasts of 2 times, each for more than 2 hours, will receive cash compensation based on the maximum number of viewers for each episode. 
[*] The maximum number of rewards per person is 4, and if you proceed same and more than 4 times, the information will be calculated based on the 4 times with the highest maximum number of viewers. 
[/list]
[/olist]
[/list]


[h3][b]Partner Streamer Termination Terms [/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] If a partner streamer wishes to cancel, he or she may go through one of the cancellation procedures below. 
[olist]
[*] Send your intention to give up being a partner via a direct message to the Discord administrator (@BLACK STIGMA, BLACK STIGMA#0524) 
[*] Send an email to Bold Play Games’ official account stating that you are giving up on being a partner (operation@boldplaygames.com)  
[/olist]

[*] Partner streamers may be terminated at the discretion of the company as follows. 
[olist]
[*] If no streaming about BLACK STIGMA is conducted based on the Global Testing Tour service.  
[*] If the category is set to BLACK STIGMA and most of the content is unrelated 
[*] If groundless slander against BLACK STIGMA and other companies' games is judged to be excessive.  
[list] ※ Constructive criticism about game is always welcome :)  [/list]
[*] If the content is judged to be highly offensive to most viewers  
[/olist]

[*] If a canceled partner wishes to participate again, please contact Bold Play Games via official email. (operation@boldplaygames.com) We will send you a separate participation application link. 
[/list]


[h3][b]FAQ (can be updated)  [/b][/h3]

[olist]
[*] I'm curious about which region the server will be opened in in my country. 
[list]
[*] Please check Steam’s region announcement page. ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1277530/view/3680059005335830828]Steam News Link[/url])  
[*] If you are not sure or your country is not listed in the notice, please contact us individually.
[list](operation@boldplaygames.com)  [/list]
[/list] 

[*] What are the ‘custom games’ that only partners can use? 
[list]
[*] This is a mode where you can enjoy the game with only the people you want in the game mode and map you want, rather than following general random matching. 
[*] In Custom Mode, in addition to being a member of the actual battle, you can also become a spectator who can see other players' perspectives. 
[/list] 

[*] How are partners selected?
[list]
[*] We personally review the Twitch channels of all applicants to ensure that their passion for channel growth and key topics match. Because we are looking for streamers who can grow together with us, number of followers or popularity are not criteria for selection. 
[*] When the selection announcement date for each region arrives, all applicants will be notified of the results by email.  
[/list]
[/olist]
 

 
We ask for the participation of streamers who dream of growth with new items. 

Best regards,
BLACK STIGMA team

notes.title: DEV Notes Part-4
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Masters. I'm Kwon Dae Ho, the Executive Producer of Black Stigma. [/b]

Since February, we haven't been able to update players on testing or service schedules.
Today, we will inform you about the test dates that will showcase the developments of the past 6 months.



[h3][b]# New Test Ahead [/b][/h3]

Based on the feedback and support we received from the past four alpha tests, 
we have been putting a lot of effort into elevating the fun of "Black Stigma." 
Now, we are planning to conduct a [b]"Global Testing Tour"[/b] in order to share the results with everyone.



[h3][b]# What is a Global Testing Tour? [/b][/h3]

A Global Testing Tour is a test that allows us to gather data 
on the gameplay characteristics and methods of the playerbase for each country 
by providing an optimal gameplay environment for different regions. 

Through this test, we will make plans for Early Access services and attempt to provide a smooth 
and pleasant gameplay experience for as many people as possible.

[list]
[*] Therefore, we have prepared testing plans for 5 regions, in which we will conduct the tests one by one.
[*] Starting at ASIA on October, we will proceed with the testing in the order of SEA->NA ->EU->LA.
[*] Anyone can participate by pressing the "Request Access" button under "Join Playtest" on the official Steam page.
[*] We are grouping countries with access to the game into regions to allow for a stable network environment (latency, ping, etc.). We ask for your participation in the tests during your region's testing dates.
[/list]



[h3][b]# Main Content of the Global Testing Tour [/b][/h3]

Since it has been 8 months since the last alpha test, we have additional content to showcase: 
[b](1) New Masters (characters); (2) Expanded weapon grades; (3) New game modes and map arrangements.[/b]

[b](1) The addition of new Masters and the establishment of each Master's play style[/b]
We have added 6 new Masters on top of the 6 existing Masters we revealed up to the last test. 
You will be able to play 12 different Masters on this test.

The 6 existing Masters were created with a solid base while reflecting the game's characteristics. 
On the other hand, the 6 new Masters are focused on a different and fresh play style. 
We highlighted each Master's unique traits during concept creation 
and further developed them in a way to allow for more unconventional gameplay.

In addition, we categorized the Masters into four different groups and gave them stats accordingly. We recommend that you try playing with various Masters and find the one that suits your play style.

[b](2) Weapon grade limit expanded to "Legendary"[/b]
Along with the addition of new Masters, there will be new Legendary grade handguns, 
which will be the highest tier for firearms. 
The main features of Legendary grade firearms include the ability to equip laser sights 
and extra ammunition attached compared to the same gun of a different grade.
Unlike crosshairs, the dot sights and laser sights in Black Stigma are optical aiming devices 
that display the exact point at which the bullet will hit.

Furthermore, Legendary firearms have more ammunition compared to other guns. 
Having more ammunition than the opponent will give you a clear advantage in long-range combat.
Legendary firearms have not only better performance but also in-depth expressions of stats 
and stylish designs to fit the title "Legendary."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/a19ab80afd7235869262973440aa9fd867def665.png[/img]
[i]  ▲ Differentiate design by grade of the same gun implemented in real games
   (left) 3D model of 'PFW30L' Rare grade gun; (right) 3D model of 'PFW30L' Legend grade gun[/i]

We take pride in the handgun gameplay of Black Stigma 
and will therefore provide players with various firearms in-game.

[b](3) Different experiences provided through new game modes and additional maps[/b]
The main game mode will be the "Kill Them All" (elimination, "KTA") mode that we revealed in the last alpha test, 
with the addition of a new PvP mode called "Team Deathmatch" ("TDM") and a PvE mode called "Challenge Mode."

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/1caae13e93325d3c1a85e501a8fb1aced698813e.png[/img]
[i]  ▲ new maps; ‘Old Manor’ and ‘Abandoned Subway’[/i]

In the "Kill Them All" mode, which is a PvP mode where you win by killing all opponents in the enemy team, 
we have added two new maps called "Decrepit Mansion" and "Abandoned Subway Station". 

On the Decrepit Mansion map, players will battle in and out of a classic mansion, 
whereas the Abandoned Subway Station features an all-indoors map 
that will provide players with a different atmosphere.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/9a09a8262d3c8be7382affa06d4b574e29752f4e.png[/img]
"Team Deathmatch" is a game mode where two teams compete for higher kills on a respawn-enabled map. 
Players killed by enemies will respawn in a safe location within a few seconds and can enjoy nonstop action without having to wait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/66053f50f0aca567dbeec1c53b5f4ddfc7077562.png[/img]
"Challenge Mode" is where players clear stages with AI bots. 
This is a single-player mode where clearing a stage will enable players to enter stages of higher difficulty.



[h3][b]# What we encourage players to do during the Global Testing Tour [/b][/h3]

[u][b]Combat that can be enjoyed in various ways [/b][/u]
Black Stigma is a "Killer Action Game". Within the world of Black Stigma, there are various killers who live their everyday lives in disguise. We aimed to provide players with a thrilling experience and create combat through each killer's unique shooting and fighting skills.

Unlike other shooting games where you have an excruciating learning period when your shooting and aiming skills are subpar, we want to provide players with an alternative combat method to face opponents. The 6 new Masters are especially focused on those aspects, so we hope you playtest all the Masters.

[u][b]Adaptation to the game through the new PvE system[/b][/u]
Since Black Stigma claims to be a PvP-focused game, we thought a system where players could prepare and practice for fair competition was required. Therefore, "Training Mode" and "Challenge Mode" were added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/cb87c65b6e003cb9b9a2f52cbceb127dad000644.png[/img] 

"Training Mode," as can be commonly seen in fighting games, is where players can practice different skills on training dummies while switching Masters and equipment. "Challenge Mode" is where players clear stages by defeating the AI bots that charge toward the player.
Find the Master and gun customization options that suit you in Training Mode and Challenge Mode, and reap the results of training in PvP game modes.

[u][b]Excitement alongside streamers[/b][/u]
Starting with this Global Testing Tour, we aim to create opportunities for Black Stigma and small streamers to grow together. We are also considering streamer support events for this cause as well.

One of those events is the "Custom Game" feature, which is a spectator-inclusive mode that can be manually controlled. Streamers can create event games through the Custom Game feature, while viewers and players can enjoy the video content produced by it.

Along the lines of the event above, we plan to support small streamers so that a mutually beneficial cycle can start between our game and the streamers. We hope people can enjoy the game and share opinions by watching its content, even if they don't play Black Stigma.



[h3][b]# What we ask of the players + Future plans [/b][/h3]

We hope the game is played and enjoyed by many players.
We worked hard to improve the aspects that we felt were lacking while going through the previous alpha tests. We are looking forward to players experiencing the three revamped game modes, various maps, and 12 unique Masters. Please give us feedback on your experience playing Black Stigma through the in-game surveys or our socials.

We plan to conclude the Global Testing Tour in December by showcasing the final Global Testing Tour build, which will be refined through the various feedback we will have received during the testing period.

We will collect feedback through various methods and use the feedback to quickly change/improve the parts that we can work on internally. We are also planning to showcase a refined, updated version in December, when all the regions of the Global Testing Tour will be coming to an end. We will unlock all content to prevent players from thinking, "How does this still not exist?" and provide an Early Access-adjacent version of the game.



[h3][b]# Lastly[/b][/h3]

The developers of Black Stigma are committed to finding a "unique type of entertainment in a shooting game." The game strives to be a perfect blend of killer action, handgun action, and close combat, which isn't a common theme among other games. In order to provide an exquisite level of entertainment, we are seeking to conduct multiple tests to identify the specific points of the game that players like and the style in which they play.

We are happy and grateful to be showing you the fruits of our hard work and trial and error over the past several years. We ask for your feedback and support through the Global Testing Tour period.
Thank you.

Sincerely, 
[b]Producer Kwon Dae Ho[/b]
