notes.title: [Solved Mysteries] ep.2 : NutCracker, the Ballerina
notes.content:
[h3][b]Black Stigma's Bombshell, Bestowed with the Art of Ballet[/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/713f45f1fdbf9674486d00f33190713a0dcddad8.png[/img]

Those who have played Black Stigma or have been in touch with the community will be familiar with this lady.

She is our one and only Ms. Nano.

Nano is praised as the most beautiful killer among the playable characters within the Black Stigma universe. 
Born in Russia, she received strict assassination training from her father and professional hitman, Hardworker Zero. 
The training between the two went on until Nano was 14 years of age.

The year Nano turned 14, Zero abandoned her and left under unknown circumstances. And for the first time in her life, Nano was free from her father's assassination training and indulged in a "normal life."

Ballet was the first thing that the youthful 14-year-old tried out in her attempt to live as an ordinary teenager. 
She knew very well how beautiful she looked, so she would have wanted to erase her bloody past through hobbies that took advantage of her appearance.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/720da4e3ffb489847d59b899621b7a0e67f383d5.jpg[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: Russian State Ballet of Siberia performing "Swan Lake", 2022-[/i][/color]

Frankly, ballet did not have a big influence on Nano's life and career as a contract killer after she reached adulthood.

It is rather that she was able to learn ballet with ease thanks to her physical abilities built from years of training.



[h3][b]Ballet from a Martial Arts Point of View[/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/4b15ea82726960f4febbda86c202b1b80f6882dd.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: Masutatsu Oyama (Choi Bae-dal a.k.a Mas Oyama, 1923–1994), one of Japan's martial arts legends[/i][/color]

Why would a photo of a karate master suddenly appear while discussing ballet? 
It is because Mas Oyama is known as the first martial artist to argue that ballet is closely related to martial arts, which was quite a peculiar statement at the time.

Mas Oyama was a Korean martial artist who became and widely known as a karate master in Japan. 
He was also famous for hosting bizarre events where he would take down a bull with just his bare hands, or battle masters from all around the world. 
His reputation began to spread globally, attracting numerous martial artists from the western hemisphere to move to Japan and become his apprentices. 

He was not only immensely powerful but also quirky in character, which later caused many movies, comic books, and media mix products to pay homage to him, including "Ryu" from the "Street Fighter" series.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/d14fbc0414abc5a0e4011ad9818ef95d998c00b3.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: Various media mix characters influenced by Mas Oyama From left to right - (1) "Doppo Orochi" from "Baki the Grappler", (2) Mas Oyama as himself, (3) "Choi Bae-dal" from "Fighter in the Wind", (4) "Ryu" from the "Street Fighter" series[/i][/color]

As a world-class fighter during the 1960s and 1970s, he would often argue that people who have pursued ballet hold a lot of potential for becoming martial artists.
Mas Oyama would stress the close connection between ballet and martial arts in various interviews and lectures, based on his experiences communicating with ballet dancers in the United States.

It is said that ballet not only requires muscles that can exert strength beyond one's weight restrictions but also flexibility and rhythm at all times. 
These characteristics of ballet inspired Mas Oyama's way of training karate.
Mas Oyama once commented that one of his ballet-dancer friends was a very strong fighter, even though he did not receive any professional training.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/e19c298946cd4b96d2f2e60db201d538a73c672d.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: Japanese magazine "Power Karate Illustrated", December 1985, Excerpts remade from Mas Oyama's lecture held in Japan, May 1978[/i][/color]



[h3][b]Ballet Training: Blood, Sweat, and Tears[/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/0336bfd8cb7a5ea566ba6a7144e4e165f4a59a02.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: Professional(?) ballerinas from "Scary Movie 5"[/i][/color]

It is extremely hard to pursue ballet as a lifetime career.
One must first meet the physical measurement requirements of prestigious ballet academies in order to follow an elite course.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/328e54b1bd4cc5f6a364dfa9a76eb5a3361197a8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/3bb052050aaf8aa1fc810d1f13baac6dfabf7f1e.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: Photo of the famous "Vaganova Academy of Russian Ballet" and their admission criteria, Female dancers of 170cm must be under 47.2kg to pass.[/i][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/b3f31ac8a81a2d7337858feba444cbc5cfc1dea4.jpg[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: Students who failed the admissions for a prestigious ballet academy, The slender, if not skinny, girl on the right failed to enroll because she weighed 5kg more than the required weight.[/i][/color]

Once they pass the harsh body measurement requirements, what lies ahead of them is a training even worse than the admission.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/16f53a458a4743a8e815295b9742f52a979aa972.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: A ballet student who got injured during an exam, He cries in pain but the coach yells at him to die backstage.[/i][/color]

As seen in the documentary footage above, professional ballet training is an endless road of pain and endurance. 
Those who make it past the agonizing training and exams are reborn as professional dancers, who not only bear extreme power but also delicate acting skills.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/f5fe9e6037315141f19558662433def4b93bd4e1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/c5b6740699a2fbb78c0a6f0fbd3ebd0ee2f697b8.gif[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: The leg muscles of ballet dancers; It is hard to notice how muscular they are, as the legs are usually covered in tights or tutus during performances.[/i][/color]



[h3][b]Modern Fighters in Pursuit of the Power of Ballet [/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/185d4594c7068b62bd30e03c5d69b9be868821d7.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: WSOF (PFL) champion David Branch in ballet training[/i][/color]

Sometimes we can see martial artists practicing ballet as part of their training.
David Branch, the PFL (mixed martial arts league; previously named WSOF) champion, is a good example.

Branch is an MMA champion who reigned over the middle to light heavyweight class from 2014 to 2015. 
After conquering the WSOF, he began to develop an interest in ballet and its merits while studying various training methods.
He eventually launched a ballet training project with the famous ballet producer and former Bolshoi Ballet dancer, Dmitri Roudnev, where the entire process was made public through social media.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/73bcf2456d2551504cd2b1d458bf7d88814c600a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/cef0d3748cf92eebf60cb88ca5f9136efc5d71b8.jpg[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: Actor Jean-Claude Van Damme's signature "360 spinning kick"[/i][/color]

Renowned actor Jean-Claude Van Damme is also a martial artist who is closely affiliated with ballet. 
The climax of his action sequence is usually finished with a spinning kick that resembles a jump in a ballet performance.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/7716be0d82f66192397fc466d773e71b62af1758.jpg[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: The Grand Jete, assumed to be the origin of Van Damme's 360 spinning kick[/i][/color]

Van Damme has been a martial artist since his youth, when he started his career with karate.
His passion for karate was so deep that he won the European Karate Championship even before coming of age.

While pursuing karate, he also practiced Muay Thai, bodybuilding, and ballet to master his martial arts skills.
It is presumed that traces of ballet can be seen in his flashy mid-air kicks because he took ballet lessons for a total of 5 years, starting when he was 16 years old.



[h3][b]The Dev Team's Love for Nano, and Conclusion[/b][/h3]


Since we've mostly talked about buff martial artists in this column, let's go back to our bombshell killer, Ms. Nano, and wrap up the story.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/b0b33a13c9b46038cc57070ad6babb759c0b1753.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source: Cases of attractive female spies/assassins, (Left) Scenes referring to the "Red Room" and "Natasha Romanov" from "Black Widow", (Right) "Yor Forger" from "Spy x Family"[/i][/color]

[b]- "Beautiful woman" + "Killer / Spy" + "Trained from an early age" etc...[/b]

These are the keywords that make up many attractive yet powerful female characters throughout various media and content in 2023.

As we continued writing the story for Black Stigma, we wanted to put as many "popular elements" as we could in Nano's character background.
Ballet was the last piece of her story that we pondered over until the end.
To sum up Nano's early life, it goes as follows:

* Mother goes missing right after Nano is born 😢
* Hitman father trains his only daughter to be a killer 😧
* Homeschooled (where the lessons were only about killing) until 14 😨
* (Perhaps we should put in "Ballet lessons as part of training," which resembles the "Red Room" from "Black Widow"... 🤔 )


At this point, we just wanted to give Nano happy memories that she could treasure.
We wanted her to enjoy ballet as the art form it is instead of as a method for killing or fighting.

We hope our little post provided you with a chance to see ballet from a new perspective.
We will be back with more interesting backstories about Black Stigma.
Thank you!



[b]The Climax of Killer Action[/b]
BLACK STIGMA Team

notes.title: DEV Notes Part-3
notes.content:
[b]Greetings.
I'm Lee Jin Seo, an AD (Art Director) with over 10 years of experience in military shooting game concept art.[/b]

The world of Black Stigma and its concepts are being built by all of us, and I'm in charge of the overall design. 

Have you seen the backstory, concept art, and 3D models we've been uploading to the community page?  
I would like to share the story of how this world and these characters were created and the incidents that happened in the process.



[h3][b][Joining the Black Stigma Project][/b][/h3]

"Come visit some time, we're making a new game!"

That's how I met the Producer, and when they showed me their ideas for the game, it seemed like a new shooting/action game like never before, not to mention I was personally interested in the story as well.
It inspired countless ideas in my head, and it looked like I could try anything.
I thought that I could be imaginative and implement different ideas in the game, which led me to join the team. 

And that game became Black Stigma.



[h3][b][Struggles of the AD: "We want the graphic style to be changed within a year"][/b][/h3]

When I joined the Black Stigma Project as an AD, the game development was focused on the game's core system and enjoyment. 

The artwork they had before was a very simple rough draft, so I had conflicting feelings of both comfort and pressure, from "Whatever I do, it'll definitely be an improvement from this" to "When am I ever going to revise all this?" 

However, there is no doubt that it was quite a weight on my shoulders to have to redefine the art style within 3 months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/2aa43fe2b3481a5142f2af8a6a8723fd168f1ca4.png[/img][color=lightgreen]< Early character design of Mr. TEN >[/color]


In shooting games with PvP modes,
there should be a fixed set of rules for each character's proportions in order to make the game fair and balanced.
Furthermore, the design must have a serious and realistic tone to match the realism and ambience that shooting games strive to generate.

However, Black Stigma is a shooting action game with many different killers.
so we had to put a lot of effort into making characters with different silhouettes and emphasizing their unique traits.  
We had to overcome the limits of creating new character designs while abiding by the restrictions on creativity. 

Therefore, rather than following the existing pattern of FPS characters doing melee combat, we've decided to have characters in the style of Street Fighter or Marvel Comics using firearms.
Considering the given deadline, current artwork, and resources from in and outside the team, we came to the conclusion of using "Toon Shaders."

[color=pink][i]※ Shading: One of the processes of surface-treating a manufactured 3D model (≒frame or surface structure) according to the situation and setting (=Rendering), which refers to the process of processing lighting/light source/chromaticity/light/reflection/blur, etc.[/i][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/cbf5177b1e81a73a1d284967d2512b3431f57abc.png[/img][color=lightgreen]< Lecture on the use of Toon Shader in Unreal Engine (YouTuber 'underscore00') >[/color]


However, I fell into despair as I got feedback after suggesting it to the team. 

"It's going to be difficult to make an FPS game immersive with the toon shaders." 
"Toon style? I'm afraid it might miss the mark on evoking a deep, breathtaking vibe in a killer action game." 
"The downside of the toon shading is that it's going to look too simple and messy." 

Even an acquaintance who worked on countless graphic design projects discouraged me by saying,
"I've seen a lot of developers try toon shading and fail."



[h3][b][We just wanted to do something unique.][/b][/h3]

While it is not difficult to see games with toon shaders, FPS and TPS games rarely use them.
This is because shooting games prioritize realism, and also because the players' fatigue level rises if the toon shaders are not applied neatly. 
In addition, toon shaders might make it difficult to distinguish characters from backgrounds, which would be an issue in a game where the contrast between friend and foe is important for fair competition.
"There were so many reasons not to do it, but I still wanted to try."
I thought it would be perfect for establishing unique visuals if we could blend the art style of Marvel Comics with the creativity-inspiring world lore of our game.

Just like everyone knows what game the image below is from, we were hoping that players would recognize the art style and say, "Is that a new Black Stigma character?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/cb5103ca63e9ae9b8566c68c7b0c9838438cdaea.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< The art of 'League of Legends' featuring a unique fantasy style >[/color]


Additionally, we've combined the PD and the team members' ideas to come to the following conclusion for our game's character design:  

"A sharp, noir art style that fits the contract killer world" 
"The base of a North American art style with the clean look of Japanese animation art" 
"Unique and trendy characters"



[h3][b][Graphics unique to Black Stigma][/b][/h3]

We applied different shaders to the background while maintaining the existing work as much as we could, but the characters' visuals had to be reworked from the ground up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/9b074dddfafd01a7adedb308daa4990ab7011ac3.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< Before making changes to the background >[/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/6b112124dab6480f46e57ae4e90efff20090dd2e.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< After making changes to the background >[/color]


We used many different shooting and fighting games, such as Street Fighter and Tekken, as references and were inspired by the animated Spider-Man film while working on the shaders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/0a284cecec3dcac948df967f0ef753c72ef6840b.jpg[/img][color=lightgreen]< The case that inspired the Toon shading challenge, Spider-Man’s Spider-verse animations >[/color]


It was a casual art style, but I believed it could work with the game, so I modified some of the elements and added it to the shaders. It looked decent when the characters and background were viewed together. I thought it had potential.

After discussing the work in progress with our new Technical Artist, we created a final "Black Stigma Style Shader."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/8cd695ac0412333fd1ade0c3b59d8c4cbec8b1db.png[/img]


In terms of character design, we were heavily inspired by the movie "John Wick," which gamers who are interested in killer action genres would have seen before.

"Mr. Parabellum" is an homage to the character "John Wick."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/3903d33854b7efbae6939da48a67de8d833c1af0.png[/img]


Thus, were born the three Masters: Mr. Parabellum, Mr. Ten, and Mr. Hollowpoint.

The idea was that all three of them wore classic suits, but the more classic they were, the harder it was to make each character stand out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/ab7aa1da43950842ade1679ed0c213fa62c36410.png[/img]


After overcoming a big hurdle, we finalized the three female characters from M.A.I.D. as well: Ms. Nano, Ms. One, Ms. Twin.
These were the six Masters we were able to reveal so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/d61975e07f66abacbf5c0604c98feab7278fe3c0.png[/img]



[h3][b][The first alpha test where the characters were revealed to the public][/b][/h3]

We were short on time, and we had to make decisions on the spot and push through.
I tried harder, knowing that everyone discouraged me from working with this style.

Time passed, and the first alpha test was scheduled. I couldn't sleep the night before the test.
Even within the team, I'd heard no comments such as "this looks good" or "this looks cool" before the game's release.
I was only hoping to avoid extremely negative feedback. 

Thankfully, there were no mentions of the graphics disrupting the gameplay, and most of the players who participated in the test gave the graphics a passing grade.

It seems like they were satisfied with the characters themselves as well.

This was when I started feeling confident about the graphics.



[h3][b][Mass production][/b][/h3]

Thanks to the positive feedback we received regarding the graphics of Black Stigma, we have settled on the art style and are now in the process of creating various unique characters.

There are already 18 different drafts for the world and Masters of Black Stigma, and there will be 24 more characters in the future, including the ones already released.

From a rough draft, like the one shown in the image, it takes 2 weeks to add details and settle on the design, skills, and equipment. Afterwards, the 3D modeling and animating team starts working on it, making the whole process take about 3 to 4 months total. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/b1e2ba996cf2c64c1da06a8928a4d512dfc6c6cf.jpg[/img]


Recently, we've been doing a better job of dividing the responsibility, which has resulted in a faster work process. 
If only the concept art could be finished sooner...

But, coming up with new characters is causing creative block...😔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/25fa6d883e0352eed5b886c012139742b2ba83eb.png[/img]


There are six characters that have been finalized and are waiting to be released.

We are planning to showcase three characters each from the two unrevealed contract killing organizations: AB: Gray Crows and AB: Hardworkers.

We've prepared trendy, stylish characters who have various traits and use rare weapons to perform action moves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/d569b3c23af6915a659d6f4bb1e66d9ab65bb17d.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< Part of the rough draft for Hardworker Zero, a member of AB: Hardworkers >[/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/9dc35b1b6b528edd3da9b9e66da2cb5d5cc3c814.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< Part of the rough draft for Gray Paper, a member of AB: Gray Crows >[/color]



[h3][b][Collaborating with an artist][/b][/h3]

This is the first reveal of our collaboration with a very famous artist who is active in both the U.S. and Korea.
I'm putting extra effort in because I'm a huge fan of this artist and I'm excited to be collaborating with them.

In some games, you see a character or costume based on a celebrity that only feels like the shell of the model.
In Black Stigma's artist collaboration, even the artist's personality and history were taken into account when creating this unique character that seamlessly blends in with the world and whose costumes and concepts will also be implemented in the game.

We can't reveal it now, but be sure to keep your eyes peeled!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/6ce9f316d7fc6459d3ec3f00156bcf88e59b4bfe.png[/img][color=lightgreen]< Our business manager told us not to reveal who it was, so here's just a little silhouette of the character >[/color]



[h3][b][Lastly][/b][/h3]

As a start-up company, we are going through many issues and attempts in development, but we have a hunger to make Black Stigma a great game.
We hope for your support and honest feedback.
We are ready to hear any kind of opinion from the playerbase.

Even today, I pressed our business manager to set a date. 
I heard that there's a test scheduled not too far in the future, so if you haven't played Black Stigma yet, we hope you participate in the test and give us feedback.  


Thank you for reading. If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment or upload a post on the community page.
We will make sure to get back to you. 

Thank you.



[b]Sincerely, Art Director Lee Jin Seo[/b]

notes.title: [Solved Mysteries] ep.1 : Why she learned JUDO?
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings, everyone! Do you like MMA?[/b][/h3]


If so, can you find a commonality among the athletes below?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/b77ccc975877e32a831b851a1d5792b34a97d017.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]Starting from the left: Yoshihiro Akiyama, Vitor Belfort, Dong Hyun Kim, Ronda Rousey[/i][/color]


What all these fighters have in common is that they are famous MMA fighters who learned Judo.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/7a546dee126f1c3f7b4b21a232fbc6ced0e6db2d.png[/img]

Judo, as many of you are aware, is one of Japan's signature martial arts.
Since its inception in 1882, Judo has been an internationally recognized martial art that has been an official Olympic sport since 1964.
It is estimated that more than 40 million people practice this sport due to its popularity. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/dd7094152792424d80877878099499591358739e.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲Martial arts derived from Judo. Starting from the left: Jiu-Jitsu, Sambo[/i][/color]

Judo focuses on throwing and grappling techniques in close matches, and its effectiveness and popularity have inspired the development of martial arts such as Jiu-Jitsu and Sambo.

Judo was regarded as the foundation for the ground techniques of mixed martial arts (MMA), which eschews the rules of individual combat sports in pursuit of realistic combat. MMA is about realistic situations, and throwing techniques that employ gravity to inflict heavy damage, or grappling techniques that subdue the enemy by targeting joints or vital points, are highly dangerous and threatening.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/55acdf82eec3ca8be67a7d7e746eb97764a169fe.png[/img]

When it comes to dealing with dangerous situations where guns aren't an option, the characters of BLACK STIGMA rely on their own unique styles of martial arts.

Ms. One, the leader of the all-female organization M.A.I.D., favors tactical and strategic combat. Her interest in chess, another charming quality of hers, also demonstrates her intelligence. 
She has been using the close-quarters fighting skills she learned in Judo to protect herself and assassinate enemies. In most people's minds, the word "Judo" conjures up images of bulky, built figures. Therefore, it may be challenging for people to associate Ms. One, who is the brains of AS, and her average figure with this image of Judo.

Then, let's take a look at Ms. One's choice of martial arts: Judo.




[h3][color=orange][b]< Active Skill 1 : (EN) Hip-Sweep, (JP) 払腰[Harai-goshi] >[/b][/color][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/56f83d41352377524900d38a4dc51e4d5e19feeb.gif[/img]

This is Ms. One sweeping her opponent up on her back and throwing them to the ground.
This skill is a recreation of a real Judo move called "Harai-goshi," or "Sweeping hip throw."


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/d3fd2ec7b86b37220dab4948ac4dd405c3f72e7c.gif[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source : Japan KODOKAN Official YouTube[/i][/color]

Leverage is the foundation of this technique, allowing for even the heaviest of foes to be slammed to the floor with relative ease. To easily flip her opponent over, she uses her waist and hips as a lever to pull their upper body with two arms, and lift their lower body with one leg.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/e7f1464fe37caa34c8f9385492ea5716e5587009.png[/img]
Although Ms. One has honed her skills over many years and is considered a veteran Master, there are definitely physical limitations to her slender physique.
As a result, she employs these techniques when pursuing male targets at least twice her size.




[h3][color=orange][b]< Active Skill 2 : (EN) Foot-Sweep, (JP) 送足払[Okuriashi harai or Okuri ashi barai] >[/b][/color][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/4f88bfa1c806a5f1d8fa7e6445a4de452480e0a9.gif[/img]

This is Ms. One's skill, where she runs up to her opponent, grabs their collar, then trips them using her foot.
This skill is a recreation of a real Judo move called "Okuri ashi barai," or "Foot sweep."


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/e3db5efecf693d46578fc2c2713565143b7b94d1.gif[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source : Japan KODOKAN Official YouTube[/i][/color]

It is also a clever skill that Ms. One utilizes to overcome her physical limitations.

Falling to the ground during a fight will almost certainly result in defeat. As you fall, you are vulnerable to both your opponent's attack and gravity's, which could result in a disastrous situation.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/4ccbf0e2a7f88878108b83f514a49e475ed1af99.gif[/img]

For this reason, most martial arts masters tend to keep their center of gravity low, both to avoid being caught off guard and to maximize the impact of their attacks when pushing down with their feet.

However, due to the fact that foot sweeps tackle opponents at their feet as their center of gravity is raised, it is easy to knock them down with less force.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/6178f086d326bd0183c0a963f4a6282611c2a805.png[/img]
When you grab an opponent's collar and lift or sway their upper body, their center of gravity rises momentarily.
If you sweep the victim's legs immediately after, the victim may appear helpless to onlookers.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/463eda2e73437e252538b0bd1dc93e23966df31e.gif[/img]
[color=lightgreen][i]▲ Source : Olympic medalists Jo Joon-ho and Jo Joon-hyun on 'Hanpan TV'[/i][/color]

Similar uses of this principle have been observed in actual street fighting, where one fighter shifts their opponent's center of mass while sweeping their legs.

Ms. One is aware that it is difficult for her to lift a larger and heavier opponent with only her strength. Since she is too weak and lightweight to make her opponents stumble, her strategy consists of sprinting towards her opponents to push them back, thereby creating an opening to sweep their legs while their center of gravity is momentarily elevated.

Although she chose Judo to overcome her weight class with intelligence, she is hesitant to use certain skills on missions. Those are "grappling techniques," which include pins, chokes, and joint locks.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/a54a8d44e18f95daae34ca39651ef1fb26bbc042.jpg[/img]

Successful grappling techniques can overcome a weight class difference to some extent.
However, Ms. One uses them sparingly. This is due to the fact that they typically do not work against opponents who are significantly heavier or more muscular than her, and can result in counterattacks.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/97756ea4f30eda15aa41485d3acd5a9d21e04c9a.gif[/img]

After accumulating a vast amount of combat experience, she had reached one conclusion.
Her formula for winning is to use Judo techniques to quickly take down her opponents, then finish them off with a gun.



Did you enjoy reading about Ms. One?
As one of the most intelligent members of AS, you can't help but notice how methodical she is, even in close combat.

Likewise, each of our characters has a theme that draws inspiration from or pays homage to real fighting techniques. 
Stay tuned for more martial arts stories from our other characters following Ms. One!



[b]The Climax of Killer Action[/b]
BLACK STIGMA Team

notes.title: DEV Notes Part-2
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Masters. I'm Kwon Dae Ho, the Producer of BLACK STIGMA.[/b] 

As I promised in the first Dev Note, I would like to share the development progress and the ideas that we considered important in the process of creating this game. 



[h3][b][BLACK STIGMA's Development Progress][/b][/h3]

We are in the process of completing the milestone set for July 30.
After we reach that milestone, we are planning to proceed with QA in August, and if there are no big issues, we will announce the dates for the testing.

There will be multiple changes in this update.
There will be 6 additional Master characters and 10 additional handguns, where each handgun will have 4 variations with a different combination of compensators, silencers, scopes, and magazines.
Additionally, as mentioned in the previous Dev Note, we are planning to showcase new, stage-based PvE content, “Challenge Mode,” apart from Training Mode.
A “Spectator Mode” for content creators (streamers) has also been developed and is scheduled for QA.
The overall UI is being renewed as well. From the Lobby to actual gameplay, we are preparing neater, higher quality visuals.

We aim to complete the build soon and announce the testing dates and changes to the game through Dev Notes.



[h3][b][Changing the BLACK STIGMA Logo][/b][/h3]

Along with the changes being made to the game, we are also in the process of re-designing the logo, which serves as a visual representation of our game.

Our AD went through quite a bit of trouble as they joined the team, but as the current B.I. (Brand Identity) was rushed during the development of the alpha version, the logo wasn't a perfect representation of our game.
Therefore, we are in the process of creating a logo that will better represent our game, and the AD is putting a lot of effort into designing a unique, memorable logo that reflects the theme and atmosphere of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/ad76d233b668a470fb9d8a52061c47ccbd5d4a94.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< Rough concept artwork for BLACK STIGMA BI >[/color]

We expect to showcase the new logo in the next Dev Note.



[h3][b][The Origin of the Name "BLACK STIGMA][/b][/h3]

We didn't have a chance to explain the origin of the name "BLACK STIGMA" yet.
During the last test, we noticed the definition of “Stigma” had caused some misunderstandings for some of the players.

BLACK STIGMA's name has to do with the world-building of the game.
The Killers in this world are given “Stigmas,” which represent their organization and themselves. “Stigmas” are flat, golden plates that can be used like stamps.
Killers get tattoos of their Stigmas or carry accessories based on them, and sometimes they leave their “Stigma” symbol on the crime scene after successfully killing their target. The purpose of this action is to enhance the reputation of their organization and themselves.
From time to time, Killers are tasked with eliminating another Killer or a tough opponent. In this case, they would send a letter marked with the seal of their Stigma, using black ink, to their target as a warning. This comes from the act of throwing down the gauntlet, which is how medieval European nobles challenged.
Someone to a duel. Killers started calling these seals a stigma of death (black), which led to the name “BLACK STIGMA.”
However, the true meaning of “BLACK STIGMA” is disclosed to only a select few individuals within the world, and the secret will gradually be unveiled as the story progresses.

With this backstory in mind, players might also find joy in looking for BLACK STIGMAs on different body parts of Killers in-game.



[h3][b][Various combat moves by the Killers in BLACK STIGMA][/b][/h3]

Following the name of the company, "BoldPlay Games," our objective was to create a killer action game that was intensive and daring.
It is a crucial aspect of the game that the Masters (Killers) you will be playing have realistic combat skills based on real-life martial arts.

As the action is the core identity of the game, we collaborated with the most brilliant stunt coordinator team in Korea, "BEST STUNT TEAM," as soon as the project began.
BEST STUNT TEAM is a group of very talented stunt performers, and they promote their dynamic performances through various movies and TV shows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/6842dea57711e312f5bfc133da4e5034d563646f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/93c60bab1579283493c8cdafa054c65af01ac4bc.png[/img][color=lightgreen]< Motion capture progress stills of the Best Stunts >[/color]

Being the professionals that they are, BEST STUNT TEAM gave us the advice that we needed, and acted out outstanding stunts.

First, we had a meeting with the martial arts director and went through the process of explaining and understanding the synopsis, game style, and the characters (Killers) of the game. Based on that information,
BEST STUNT TEAM created some preview action videos, and through a meeting with both parties involved, we were able to decide on a list of necessary martial arts moves.
We prepared a list of actions for the game, attached the appropriate motion capture equipment to the actors from BEST STUNT TEAM, and started recording the various martial arts moves we were planning to implement in the game.
Not only did we acquire outstanding martial arts moves through the collaboration with BEST STUNT TEAM, but we also received recommendations for more types of martial arts and skills. It is thanks to the team that we were able to elevate the Killers' action moves to a more impressive and realistic level.


[b][i][color=yellow]-How Mr. Parabellum's " Throwdown Kick" was created-[/color][/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/b023a44683ccf9ebc29375f0c024019b6a2120f1.gif[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< Real martial arts motion capture scene >[/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/0f24f6c6efee45ee69f737ffd5510f65eaa68011.gif[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< Extracting motion capture animations >[/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/2ecc568f6194c76ce627ae66d32ddd41d31f82ab.gif[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< Applied Game Screen >[/color]

The unique martial arts moves that were implemented for each Master will allow the players to experience diverse gameplay and will give them the opportunity to discover a character that fits their playstyle.
We suggest all players experience the different martial arts moves each Master has in the upcoming testing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/f98635f1fbd649fe95c29e549e69ef887ba4603e.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< Main melee techniques that are available in the current version of the game >[/color]



[h3][b][Movie-like Action][/b][/h3]

Melee combat techniques aside, we also focused on making our game more realistic compared to other games. One aspect of it is the difficulty of handgun shooting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/e8899b0947fb78fdf8ee2845db6c834f2a8faa6c.jpg[/img]
In the case of a handgun, it becomes very difficult to hit the target from a distance.
This is because many elements necessary for precise aiming were sacrificed for the handgun's portability.

A prime example would be the fact that it is very difficult to shoot in quick succession due to the lack of parts to shoulder the gun.
Even so, could a martial artist charge into a crowd of handgun-armed individuals, dodging bullets, and take them down using close-quarters combat?
That seems very unlikely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/3a64fd76fc99785a4d97fec5a55b23cf6c936666.gif[/img]

The recent development of bulletproof vests has made it more difficult for armed individuals, even skilled ones, to quickly subdue the enemy.
Hence, shooting techniques that subdue the opponent with a handgun, like the “Double Tap” and the “Mozambique Drill,” have been developed. 

We believe that BLACK STIGMA has found a good balance between the pros and cons of “handgun shooting” and made it entertaining in the game.


However, we believe that the way we implemented handgun shooting in the game felt uncanny to players who were more accustomed to typical FPS shooting games.
We observed that the recreation of semi-automatic pistols was executed well, but it appeared strange to players who were used to the rapid-firing of automatic guns.
This strangeness was amplified because the close-quarters combat animation did not meet expectations at the time.

After going through four alpha tests, we have come to the following conclusion.
“Aim for movie-like action with the addition of realistic details.”

As of now, we've discovered a point where one can experience the fun of killer action games.
We are balancing out the game for more synergy between shooting and close-quarters combat so that players will be able to play as if they were the protagonists of an action movie. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/a84404c2b634c25f9ce7eed312b320858534b9b8.png[/img]
[color=lightgreen]< A still from the John Wick movie series >[/color]



[h3][b][Lastly...][/b][/h3]

When a game is revealed to the public, that game is no longer the sole property of the developers.
It becomes the players' game.
Since the game has not been fully released yet, we believe this to be a crucial time where we can share our development concerns with the community and go through numerous trials and errors.


We are putting everything we have into making a killer action shooting game that you've never experienced before.
We value the playerbase's feedback in the development of this game.
We hope this will be an open game that we create with the community. And we aim to keep improving the game with your feedback.

We eagerly await your interest and participation.
Thank you.



[b]Sincerely, Producer Kwon Dae Ho[/b]

notes.title: [Season.1] Person Information - Ms. Twin
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/0c2e9d53aa3ab3c7a61f337de78e73c28bb84c92.png[/img]

[b][Character Introduction][/b]
[list]
[*] Codename: Ms. Twin (Affiliation: AS:M.A.I.D.)
[*] Role within the organization: Spy agent at M.A.I.D.
[*] Real name: Lottie [Free Woman]
[/list]
She is a school uniform and general uniform enthusiast, with long limbs and a youthful face. She lies about her age and currently attends high school. Her specialty is infiltrating by changing uniforms based on the mission situation. Because she enjoys wearing uniforms, she volunteers for the spy missions in M.A.I.D.

[b][Position][/b]
- Infiltrator
[list]
[*] As soon as the mission begins, she moves swiftly to the objective point to gain a tactical advantage.
[*] Twin's long limbs and athletically trained legs make it difficult for her opponents to maintain a comfortable distance from her. 
[/list]

[b][Specs][/b]
[list]
[*] Age: 28
[*] Height: 176cm
[*] Weight: 66kg
[*] Physique: Slim / tall, long limbs, model-like figure, quick reflexes, agile, lightweight
[*] Sport: Track and field (Sprinting)
[*] Rival: Ms. Nano
[*] Associate: Hardworker Zero
[*] Likes: Running, riding bicycles, uniforms
[*] Dislikes: Old souls, beasts, binge eating, plans
[/list]

[b][Character Attributes][/b]
[i]"I don't put myself under stress. I just do what I want. Hehe![/i]
[list]
[*] She loves to explore around her school while riding a bicycle. Being very social, she's the kind of person who'll talk to anyone on the street.
[*] "Lottie" is derived from the French term for ""free woman."" Her parents chose this name for her so she could live as free as the wind. She loves her name very much.
As a young girl, she focused solely on track and field and was unaware of her own beauty. However, since joining AS, she has become interested in enhancing her appearance, as if to compensate for her life thus far.
[*] Aside from contract killing, she enjoys school life, to the point where she would lie about her age and enroll in school. She is obsessed with the uniform-wearing school life she never had because of her complete dedication to track and field. This is also probably why she has a hobby of working part-time in occupations where she can work in a uniform. She collects costumes and accessories that will make her look like a teenager, in addition to wearing uniforms.
[/list]

[b][Personality][/b]
[list]
[*] She gets infuriated when someone tells her that she appears to be in her late twenties, which is her true age.
[*] She is the most sociable and energetic person at AS, but her temper is unlike any other when she is angry.
[*] She treats everyone she meets for the first time with kindness and affection.
[*] She enjoys living spontaneously and despises planning.
[*] The traumatic experience of having been kidnapped and almost sold by human traffickers at the age of 16 revealed her latent desire for violence and murder.
[/list]

[b][Relationships][/b]
[list]
[*] Generally, she is very outgoing.
[*] She has a history with Hardworker Crush. Of all the people in both AS and AB, Crush is the only one who seems to know everything about her past.
[*] Twin is usually kind to everyone, with the exception of Hardworker Grasper. He occasionally visits the fast-food restaurant Twin works at, and she frowns every time he walks in.
She expresses her distaste for him in petty ways, like getting his order wrong on purpose or intentionally serving his food later.
[/list]

[b][Physical Attributes][/b]
[list]
[*] Brunette with doll-like features. 
Her emerald-green, cat-like eyes make her look even more attractive.
[*] Stands at 176cm, with long arms and legs that make her proportions look even better.
[*] She didn't give much thought to cosmetics when she was in her teens, instead concentrating on track and field.
However, she must have stunning physical features for a modeling agency to want to scout her
[*] Her carefree personality and impeccable fashion sense demonstrate how French she is. She also enjoys wearing various school uniforms as the foundation for her fashion, despite being in her late twenties.
[/list]

[b][Character Object][/b]
[list]
[*] Old running shoes with sand
[*] Old running shoes she used to wear during her track and field days. It symbolizes her passion and determination.
[*] Bicycle
[*] Represents her desire to experience a ""normal teenage life"" she never had. She uses it to ride around her school.
[/list]

[b][Habits][/b]
[list]
[*] She has a habit of leaning on one leg and concealing her weapon behind her back as combat begins.
[/list]

[b][Hobbies][/b]
[list]
[*] Cosplay, collecting school uniforms
[*] Collecting various uniforms from part-time jobs
[*] Watching slasher/horror movies"
[/list]

notes.title: [Season.1] Person Information - Ms. Nano
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/38b7dba4f85e367a82c3bdcf53216fd227e39e80.png[/img]

[b][Character Introduction][/b]
[list]
[*] Codename: Ms. Nano (Affiliation: AS:M.A.I.D.)
[*] Role within the organization: The next successor of M.A.I.D.
[*] Real name: Элина (Elena)
[/list]
A flashy and acrobatic woman who confuses her opponents with irregular behavior patterns that resemble parkour and gymnastics. She likes using her dagger for quick slashes and her small, fast, throwing knives to get the job done.

Her twisted character was the result of a childhood filled with complicated relationships. As her relationship with her father deteriorated, her personality got worse.

She is considered the organization's troublemaker due to her unpredictability, cynicism, and irritability. However, she is an expert in regard to her ability to carry out operations.

[b][Position][/b]
- Striker
[list]
[*] When engaging in combat, she favors firearms and daggers. Daggers are a great way to complement her short reach and lack of strength in close combat.
[*] In situations where firearms are difficult to use, she resorts to throwing her hidden knives to restrict the enemy's movement before closing the distance and going for the kill.
[/list]

[b][Specs][/b]
[list]
[*] Age: 23
[*] Height: 165cm
[*] Weight: 40kg
[*] Physique: Slim
[*] Sport: Ballet
[*] Rival: Ms. Twin
[*] Associate: Mr. Parabellum
[*] Likes: New luxury items, fashion, daggers, the scarlet color of blood
[*] Dislikes: Physical touch, chatting
[/list]

[b][Character Attributes][/b]
[i]"Ugh, dammit! Hey, you!! Stop being such a nuisance and die already."[/i]
[list]
[*] Elena is the name of a character in a book that Zero enjoyed reading as a child. When Nano was a newborn, he would sit next to Nano's crib before sunrise and read the novel. It was then that he decided to name Nano after the novel's protagonist.
[*] She has tried on almost every dress and accessory that exists in the world.
However, she detests dresses that make her seem like a princess and prefers dresses that accentuate her figure.
[*] She satisfies all the criteria to be considered beautiful, although her cynical and irritable personality makes others question her capabilities as an assassin. On the one hand, she strongly disapproves of being assigned missions in which her beauty is used as a weapon. On the other hand, she enjoys wearing flashy makeup, accessories, and outfits that highlight her figure. Others find it difficult to deal with her unpredictability because of this dichotomy.
[/list]

[b][Personality][/b]
[list]
[*] She has difficulty improvising in different situations, and she expresses her emotions as they are.
[*] Her normal expression screams annoyance and irritability, but she switches to a blank face before each murder, revealing her true motivations to onlookers.
[*] She sympathizes with the sick and dying. She tries to hide it, however, by looking annoyed and speaking cynically.
[/list]

[b][Relationships][/b]
[list]
[*] Her father, Zero, abandoning her when she was a child has always been a source of trauma for her.
[*] She is worried about meeting her father again because they might one day cross paths as assassins instead of having a happy father-daughter family reunion.
[*] Her traumatic experiences with men stem from the emotional wounds inflicted by her father. When she meets someone for the first time, she is harsher on men than on women.
[*] Her father's absence has made her needy. So, once she has given her heart to a man, she will lavish him with love. It is interpreted as her way of compensating for the love she did not receive from her father. When it comes to romantic relationships, she is the polar opposite of Twin, who sees men as more of a toy than a person.
[*] Men surround her like moths to a flame, yet she still feels empty and lonely. Despite her feelings, she is always assigned missions involving men and is therefore discontent with everything. Nonetheless, she still gives her all when she begins work.
[/list]

[b][Physical Attributes][/b]
[list]
[*] She is a petite Russian beauty with luscious red hair styled in loose waves.
[*] She has a well-toned, voluptuous figure.
[*] She takes pleasure in accessorizing herself with bright jewelry and figure-flattering outfits.
[*] She modifies rapiers into daggers and wears hidden knives on her thigh.
[/list]

[b][Character Object][/b]
[list]
[*] Bouquet: Flowers with traumatic memories of her father.
[/list]

[b][Habits][/b]
[list]
[*] She frequently tidies her hair and tucks it back.
[/list]

[b][Hobbies][/b]
[list]
[*] Reading women's fashion magazines"
[/list]

notes.title: [Season.1] Person Information - Ms. One
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/832c0d4a1c2fad9793d0e3503401c717c1f3b550.png[/img]

[b][Character Introduction][/b]
[list]
[*] Codename: Ms. One (Affiliation: AS:M.A.I.D.)
[*] Role within the organization: The leader of M.A.I.D. and successor of AS
[*] Real name: Emilia [Rival]
[/list]
A capable woman in her mid-30s who serves as M.A.I.D.'s leader. She is regarded as the brains of the organization due to her superior strategic planning and adaptability. She is more suited to being a spy than an assassin.

She is a candidate to be the next leader of AS and is the typical hardworking individual with determination and persistence. She has excellent leadership abilities and can quickly assess situations.

[b][Position][/b]
- Disruptor
[list]
[*] Her trademark is poisonous smoke bombs, which represent her clever strategic abilities.
[*] She wears a mask because of her neck and mouth disability. Additionally, the mask acts as a barrier against external impact and toxic substances.
[*] She finds the right timing to create chaos, infiltrates enemy lines during the confusion, and defeats them with her judo abilities.
[/list]

[b][Specs][/b]
[list]
[*] Age: 33
[*] Height: 173cm
[*] Weight: 70kg
[*] Physique: Standard, slender
[*] Sport: Judo
[*] Rival: Mr. Ten
[*] Associate: Mr. Parabellum
[*] Likes: Reading, meditating, camping, playing chess
[*] Dislikes: Trickery, wickedness, cheating, laziness
[/list]

[b][Character Attributes][/b]
[i]"I'll take care of everything. So don't just stand there; move according to plan."[/i]
[list]
[*] No one can figure out what she is thinking. Furthermore, the mechanical mask covers most of her face, so her expressions are hard to recognize. She has a cold aura around her.
[*] Her name, Emilia, derives from the Latin word ""rival."" Ms. One legally changed her name upon reaching adulthood. Her name reflects her determination to live a life of fighting and the pursuit of victory.
[*] For a contract killer, she has a fairly normal personality and values, so her coworkers consider her an odd person.
[*] Her capabilities for strategic planning are unparalleled. She is known for her meticulousness. She foresees every potential problem and devises solutions before they arise.
[/list]

[b][Personality][/b]
[list]
[*] She is obsessed with devising the perfect battle strategies and plans.
[*] She is the most logical female agent at AS.
[*] Her desire for victory and success is excessive, which occasionally leads to trouble.
[/list]

[b][Relationships][/b]
[list]
[*] Her silver tongue has the power to persuade almost any foe. If there is one person she can't get through to, it would have to be Gray Hand.
[*] She has an amicable relationship with Nano. She intends to appoint Nano as her successor.
[*] After the fight with Gray Hand, she developed a fear of being around other people and now prefers to be sent on solo missions as opposed to joint operations.
[/list]

[b][Physical Attributes][/b]
[list]
[*] She is a Caucasian woman from England with brown hair.
[*] Her mannerisms and fashion changed dramatically after she was grievously wounded by Hand.
[*] Before the Gray Hand incident
- She wore suits and had long hair.
- Her voice was commanding and assured, and she delivered speeches accompanied by confident hand gestures.
[*] After the Gray Hand incident
- She cut her hair short and now only wears slim-fit, dark-colored outfits with long boots.
- She has smokey eye makeup above the mask she wears due to her disability, and she began wearing a cape as if she were trying to cover herself.
- Her vocal chords are damaged, so she communicates through her mask, which amplifies her voice. Her words appear to echo throughout the space as a result of the amplification.
[/list]

[b][Character Object][/b]
[list]
[*] Black chess board, bronze chess pieces
[*] It shows her tendency to make a move only after strategizing and calculating all instances.
[*] Mr. Hollow Point suggested Ms. One take up chess to improve her mental health after she was devastated by Hand and fell into deep darkness.
[*] Following his advice, she purchased a chess board from a store she passed and began playing by herself. When she had time, she would play chess in the conference room with Mr. Ten, who also plays chess.
[/list]

[b][Habits][/b]
[list]
[*] She has a habit of unconsciously touching her mask. 
[*] She occasionally adjusts her mask as if it were slipping down her face.
[/list]

[b][Hobbies][/b]
[list]
[*] Playing chess
[*] Reading classic books
[*] Watching war movies and then strategizing as if she were the commander in the film
[/list]

notes.title: [Season.1] Person Information – Mr. Hollow Point
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/25178a8533c3ba1f3df4e248d77fd9fa030eedcf.png[/img]

[b][Character Introduction][/b]
[list]
[*] Codename: Mr. Hollow Point[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1277530/announcements/detail/3677800769861028421] (Affiliation: Master)[/url]
[*] Role within the organization: Negotiator of AS
[*] Real name: Robert [Bright fame]
[/list]
Most Masters' missions consist of passing on tasks and negotiating rather than working hands-on in the field. Mr. Hollow Point has the worst of it since he is hardly ever sent to directly engage in operations.
He is generally tasked with negotiating, but is also active in the field of hacking. He is one of the top hackers in the world.

[b][Position][/b]
- Disruptor
[list]
[*] He prefers missions based on hacking rather than missions that require direct contact because he is not fond of participating in combat. 
[*] However, on solo missions, sometimes hacking and combat go hand in hand. He opts for a secure kill with no witnesses and takes down his targets using compact explosives.
[/list]

[b][Specs][/b]
[list]
[*] Age: 26
[*] Height: 182cm
[*] Weight: 81kg
[*] Sport: Throwing
[*] Physique: Slender, agile
[*] Rival: Gray Paper
[*] Associate: Ms. One
[*] Likes: Tattoos, slim fit suits, toys (weapons)
[*] Dislikes: Strictness, pressure
[/list]

[b][Character Attributes][/b]
[i]"Do you know how to use your brain? It's not polite to your brain, tsk!"[/i]
[list]
[*] He is a cigarette addict. He starts getting anxious when he doesn't hear the clicking sound of his gold lighter regularly.
[*] "Robert" is a name he gave himself when he promised he'd live a new life after running away from the orphanage. As of now, he has not fulfilled his promise.
[*] He has characteristics of Swedish origin and is a good-looking man with blonde hair and blue eyes. He is about 180cm tall and has an average build that does not stand out.
[*] He wears a suit that is classy but has distinctive colors, and he likes to modify classic gear by adding digital functions.
[*] He favors using leather products such as leather wallets, watches, pouches, and more. He enjoys owning items with carbon fiber or titanium textures.
[*] He is the youngest among Masters and has the best taste in fashion.
[*] He likes tall buildings, but he is afraid of heights and is not familiar with long-range shooting from buildings.
[/list]

[b][Personality][/b]
[list]
[*] Carries around a gold lighter in the inside pocket of his jacket. Has a great fondness for vodka.
[*] Loves the clicking sound when he lights his lighter. It is also used as a signal to indicate the start of a battle.
[*] As a despicable man who doesn't like being at the forefront, he prefers to engage from a long distance. When he runs into an opponent up close, he uses his taser or sticky bombs to threaten the opponent.
[/list]

[b][Relationships][/b]
[list]
[*] Due to his introverted nature, he experiences difficulties in missions where he has to be in direct contact with others.
[*] He knows a side of Ms. One that the other Masters don't.
[*] He resembles the way she is very goal-driven and obsessive over strategies.
[/list]

[b][Physical Attributes][/b]
[list]
[*] Blue eyes, blonde hair, limp movement, hunched posture
[*] He has a tattoo that covers his body, up to his neck. He opts for outfits that cover up all of his tattoos and button them all the way up.
[*] He does not give off great first impressions because of his dark, depraved atmosphere. However, his gorgeous looks are bound to attract the attention of others. His appearance is utilized to charm women during individual missions.
[*] He usually wears primary-colored suits that are slim-fitted, but he also dresses himself in black leather jackets, fur coats, and more that complement his image.
[/list]

[b][Character Object][/b]
[list]
[*] Laptop
[*] Briefcase that contains gear
[*] They are tools that showcase his skills as a hacker, as well as gear that are primarily used in long-range battles. The items reflect his despicable nature.
[/list]

[b][Habits][/b]
[list]
[*] Lighting the lighter on and off
[*] Fixing his hair while looking in the mirror
[/list]

[b][Hobbies][/b]
[list]
[*] Hacking servers to crash them
[*] Creating useless hacking programs
[*] Watching gory movies
[/list]

notes.title: [Season.1] Person Information - Mr. Parabellum
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/eb7cfa1d5a1d4ba5eb85ee62500a023fe238bbdd.png[/img]

[b][Character Introduction][/b]
[list]
[*] Codename: Mr. Parabellum [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1277530/announcements/detail/3677800769861028421](Affiliation: Master)[/url]
[*] Role within the organization: The armorer for AS
[*] Real name: Alberto [Noble, bright]
[/list]
He is a legend within the contract killing world. He may have the face of a weak, benign, old dog, but he does not hesitate to use cruel methods to get the job done, which resulted in him becoming a source of fear among the other hitmen.
After witnessing him survive after pushing ahead with countless reckless attacks and infiltration, people started calling him "Specter," the ghost with Lady Luck on his side.

[b][Position][/b]
- Striker
[list]
[*] He is an expert in small arms, especially handguns, to the point where he would have no problem handling any gun in the world. He is also quite obsessed with the process of preparing his weapon of choice.
[/list]

[b][Specs][/b]
[list]
[*] Age: 36
[*] Height: 186cm
[*] Weight: 73kg
[*] Sport: Aikido
[*] Physique: Long and slim
[*] Rival: Gray Hand
[*] Associate: Mr. Ten
[*] Likes: Gun maintenance, making bullets
[*] Dislikes: Small talk, meddling
[/list]

[b][Character Attributes][/b]
[i]“You want my gun? Well, let's see how you deal with guns?”[/i]
[list]
[*] All of his love is focused on the handgun he is holding. A prayer to Lady Luck, and a kiss to his gun. To him, the kiss holds great power, as if it brings good luck.
[*] He is 185cm tall, has a slim figure, and is highly proficient in the use of firearms.
[*] His real name "Alberto" not only means "noble," but also represents "bright," "family," and "friendship."
[*] His indifferent face, which is difficult to read, exudes lethargy and puts people on edge. Since his only interests are firearms and suits, he prefers classic and fine attire.
[*] Even gunsmiths are jealous of his excellent repairing and remodeling skills, so the guns that are said to have been handled by Mr. Parabellum are coveted by everyone in the field. However, he believes in the superstition that his luck is only sustained by his guns. If he doesn't get injured during a mission, he assumes that the gun died in his place, and dismantles the gun.
[/list]

[list]
[*] He is apathetic about most things and rarely expresses his feelings towards the other members of Master. He is only interested in guns and has named every gun he owns.
[*] His indifferent face, which is difficult to read, exudes lethargy and puts people on edge.
[/list]

[b][Relationships][/b]
[list]
[*] He is very loyal to the organization and the team. This caused conflict between him and Mr. Hollow Point, who has the opposite nature.
[*] He is friends with Ms. One. They have been comfortable with each other for a very long time, and that has caused them to influence each other's combat styles significantly.
[/list]

[b][Physical Attributes][/b]
[list]
[*] Tall, long limbs, short hair Is growing a short beard.
[*] He is multiethnic and has both eastern and western features.
 : He has a European body and face, and East Asian eyes and hair.
[/list]

[b][Character Object][/b]
[list]
[*] Broken gun : Represents his love and care for all guns.
[/list]

[b][Habits][/b]
[list]
[*]He has a habit of unconsciously kissing his gun before a battle begins.
[/list]

[b][Hobbies][/b]
[list]
[*] Naming guns
 : There are over 100 guns that he has named so far.

[b][Character Introduction][/b]
[list]
[*] Codename: Mr. Ten[https://steamcommunity.com/games/1277530/announcements/detail/3677800769861028421] (Affiliation: AS_Masters)[/url]

He has no trouble socializing and forming relationships due to his outgoing personality, but he is uncompromising about the people who betray his trust and will reevaluate their relationship. As a result of his resolute nature and competence, members of AS expect him to be the next leader.

[b][Position][/b]
- Markman
[list]
[*] Almost instinctively observes others' movements.

[list]
[*] Age: 41
[*] Height: 190cm
[*] Weight: 110kg
[*] Physique: Heavy / muscular
[*] Sport: Boxing

[*] Associate: Mr. Parabellum

notes.title: DEV Notes Part-1
notes.content:
[h3][b][Greetings from the Executive Producer] [/b][/h3]
 
Hello, Masters. 
My name is Kwon Dae Ho, and I am the producer of the killer action shooting game, "Black Stigma." 
Our company is a development team formed by colleagues who have worked together for years developing and servicing shooting games. We have come together with a shared determination to introduce a new level of gameplay to the shooting genre.
 
Thanks to the contributions of individuals supporting the development of Black Stigma and the dedication of our colleagues, we were able to unveil the game to the world in September of last year. 
We are grateful to the many gamers from around the world who showed interest in the game and participated in the testing process. Your valuable feedback allowed us to make swift decisions and make rapid progress in the game's development. 
We have conducted a total of four playtests, focusing on build stability, local network testing, and game mode and content balance.
 


[h3][b][Approval of Our Intentions for the Game]  [/b][/h3]
 
Our primary goal with the game was to blend the excitement of melee combat into the framework of a predominantly long-range shooting game. We aimed to create a realistic combat experience by implementing authentic gunplay and practical combat techniques to overpower opponents armed with weapons. Through this approach, we wanted players to explore a fresh style of action gameplay. 

Additionally, we focused on designing characters specifically suited to this game concept and constructing a cohesive universe that aligns with it. 
 
During the alpha test, one of the enjoyable aspects was discovering that much of the users' feedback aligned with our initial plans and intentions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/f1db58950ccb7a6823827e8a0be296a5a2b89232.png[/img]

These experiences have served as a significant driving force in the development of Black Stigma, and they have also made us realize that there are many challenges ahead that we need to address. 
Most notably, we were able to make new attempts and receive diverse feedback on the game modes.



[h3][b][The Introduction of Bounty Game Mode] [/b][/h3]
 
In the early stages, the main game mode we presented was "Bounty Mode," which is based on team deathmatch rules. In this mode, teams would earn bounties based on their gameplay results, and the team that accumulated the most bounties would emerge as the victor.

Since Black Stigma aims to introduce a new gameplay style and considering the need for players to become familiar with the game, we had decided to showcase the "Bounty Mode" rules. This mode is based on the widely recognized team deathmatch mode, but with some unique elements added to it.  

In an alpha test conducted over three sessions, we noticed that players who showed great interest in the game quickly grasped the rules of Bounty Mode. This mode awards bounties based on gameplay results, and the team that collects the most bounties emerges as the winner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/5d5a902fda7b16f1dd0beb3b7add1e11bec66af1.png[/img]


[h3][b][Main Mode Changed to "Kill-Them-All Mode"] [/b][/h3]
 
Our original plan was to start with a mode based on widely recognized rules such as "Bounty Mode", and then gradually introduce a mode focused on teamwork.

In the last alpha test, it was confirmed that each Master's skills were playable with their unique attributes and roles. This led us to consider that it would be a good idea to develop and introduce "Kill-them-all Mode" based on elimination rules, which emphasizes clearer role-based gameplay and teamwork, at a rapid pace. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/4891a61a19bf7fcc6933f809574251101ab7bf05.png[/img]

"Kill-them-all Mode," introduced in the fourth alpha test, is a mode that emphasizes team-based cooperation and tactical gameplay. It adds a strategic element to skill usage and highlights the unique characteristics of each Master, resulting in an exciting gameplay experience.

If players were able to experience the thrill of rapid combat in "Bounty Mode," "Kill-them-all Mode" offered them the opportunity to explore the game's characteristics at their own pace, resulting in a heightened sense of competitiveness.



[h3][b][Training Mode and Various Content, Yet to Come] [/b][/h3]

Black Stigma showcases a gameplay pattern of melee combat, utilizing mid-range gunfights and melee action skills, in contrast to the long-range battles typically found in traditional FPS or TPS games.

We discovered that the players' understanding of a Master's combat styles and skills, as well as their development in gameplay sense to use them effectively in different situations, greatly influences the outcome of the battles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/79896559dc6db0132492d0f103e3460d3b846f72.png[/img]

In the upcoming test, we are preparing to introduce "Training Mode," which will allow players to thoroughly explore the various ways of utilizing each Master before engaging in actual gameplay.

Training Mode is composed of three types of training fields, where players are able to select any Master and practice shooting and active skills. 
We anticipate that Training Mode, equipped with AI-controlled bots and custom configuration including armor settings, will be beneficial for learning and mastering Black Stigma's content. 

Furthermore, we have completed or are currently developing various content, such as a new mode called "Challenge," new Masters and firearms, new stages, QoL features, and UI improvements. We are striving to enhance their quality to gather feedback from our users.



[h3][b][Service and Communications Schedule] [/b][/h3]
 
Since the last alpha test in February, we have not been sharing any service schedules, and we assume many of our users have been wondering what is going on. 
Our current development milestone is expected to wrap up around the end of July, and we will conduct a test around early October to collect user feedback. 
We will try our best to announce a more detailed test schedule within August at the latest. 

We plan to release Developer Notes at least once a month to show our development progress and processes. Through Developer Notes, we will be presenting the content in development and our intention behind it for the version in development. 
Should you have any questions, please post them on any of our community channels before our next Development Notes, and we will select a few out of them and give you an answer in the next session. 

We express our gratitude to the users who are eagerly awaiting Black Stigma, and we will endeavor to make it a game that we can create together through communication. 

 

Thank you. 

[b]Sincerely, Producer Kwon Dae Ho[/b]

notes.title: Narrative season 1 story
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/cf751ca05ca148af8e1cce097b33ac6501050b04.png[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/bf5d1093c02b5f7d0c5e125ffef4959e1a368bf1.png[/img]

[h2][b]< Prologue >[/b][/h2]
Lurking among us in the light of day, there are those who live a life of darkness. 
They take lives for a living and have formed an institution of their own. 

There is the traditional contract killing organization, [b]AS (Achromatic Servant), [/b]
and the unconfined and emerging contract killing agency, [b]AB (AnyBody).[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/36d27b4294e1b7f979fdd4c686d22c307e79683a.png[/img]
 
[h2][b]< AS : Achromatic Servant >[/b][/h2]
AS has worked throughout the years using a secluded mansion somewhere in the France-Switzerland border as their base of operations. 

AS started as a small community of "Masters"–"professional servants" who killed and gathered intel for major political and financial figures since the 18th century. Generation after generation, their influence grew as they became an organization specializing in assassination and intel services.

The organization's founder, "Mr. One", reestablished the group by implementing a more professional system and naming it "AS". Members of "AS" operate by disguising themselves as generic employees, such as secretaries, butlers, waitresses, and construction workers. 

[b]"Unnoticeable by those who deserve to live and only noticeable to those who do not." [/b]
“AS” values quiet and efficient execution hidden from plain sight.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/d3365548be9522cf3a5bfe28cef8b6ca11d30bf4.png[/img]
 
[h2][b]< AB : AnyBody >[/b][/h2]
After the passing of "Mr. One", "Mr. Anyone" was vested with total control of "AS" as its second leader. As a graduate of the "Academy," an institution within "AS" that trains young members, "Mr. Anyone" has proved his skill and talent since he was a juvenile.

However, for some reason, “Mr. Anyone” took things into a different direction from when “Mr. One” was in charge. He claimed that the "Academy" was a device that suppressed human nature and free will. 

Not long after, "Mr. Anyone" left the organization with "Zero," who was a member of "Hardworkers," which was group within "AS" that shared a common goal. Together, they took over an external force known as the "Gray Crows" to establish a new organization now known as "AB (AnyBody)".

With the two commanding men at the helm, agents from "AB" will do anything to get the job done, even cruelty or mass murder.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/65504fd82462c90788a1d8341520a53abd84663a.jpg[/img]
 
[h2][b]< Conflict between ‘AS’ and ‘AB’ >[/b][/h2]
Meanwhile, as "AB" was a combination of internal and external forces that were hostile to "AS", 

it was fated that they would be in opposition to "AS". With the addition of the members that "Mr. Ten" banished from "AS," the resentment they held towards "AS" only worsened.

The two institutions are extreme opposites in their pasts, their values, and their natures. 
And now, driven by an age-old resentment, "AS" and "AB" point their guns at each other.

notes.title: NEXT FEST Current Situation and Future Plans
notes.content:
We received the results of the delayed Steam Next Fest review from Steam this morning.

They said that the game review is getting longer according to Steam policy because there is a possibility that the prizes for the promotion events prepared for users may cause problems.

We are very sorry to the users who have been continuously interested in and waiting for the game.

We are taking an action by contacting Steam for the open as quickly as possible, but Steam has not responded to the progress other than the usual announcement which will take more time. Therefore it is hard to give you a definite answer to the opening schedule.

If it is not possible to open during the NEXT FEST period, we will open our own test server to present to users within February 2023.
If so, we will re-announce the test schedule and method again.

We apologize the service was not smooth enough, and we would like to express our gratitude to who have been interested in and waiting for our game until now.

notes.title: This part deals with combat controls to prepare the new Masters for their first
notes.content:
Next up are the controls used in combat.



[h3][b]Shooting[/b][/h3]

Just like any other 3D shooters, you can right-Click to switch to the first-person view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/efbbfe7c98d362e03d74cf4f07d6c05001258324.gif[/img]


This zoomed-in perspective allows you to take a more accurate shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/a65b9ab108ec7761e81bd15cbdcc90561a4cf55d.gif[/img]


You can also shoot in the third-person view. It grants you more speed in shooting at the expense of accuracy.
Keep in mind, however, that certain Masters prefer ambidextrous shooting and will allow you to shoot only in the third-person view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/f5c53b48d687f0283a7e4fb70dbbea177018340e.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/4257ff6760176a7736cba6b8164886bd5266b9ef.gif[/img]


Certain types of firearms have accessories such as laser sights and dot sights for your convenience in increased accuracy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/0a9ffe31946e9e9c0dd93eca64dea122cdf59764.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/56a76830cc432ce0ef1ec29b3e8ab3c73ede75c6.gif[/img]


Pistols, the main player in BLACK STIGMA, can also be thrown at the enemy.
You can throw the gun by pressing the Fire button again after using up the ammo.
Please note that only the loot can be thrown, not the basic equipment of your Master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/c0ccdd8402eba4d23c1ada8b659dfa2ba5f124db.gif[/img]


Press R to reload your weapon.
Masters often have unique reloading motions. Be sure to check them out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/574456ed0ea38dae421563a5b89877553c352569.gif[/img]



[h3][b]Active Skills[/b][/h3]

Every Master has their own unique combat skills.
Respond to the ever-changing battlefield with the Space, E, Q, and Shift keys.
Shall we take a look at some different forms of skills?


[b]1. Strikes[/b]
Strikes were modeled after the techniques used in various types of martial arts we are familiar with.
A lot of the combo moves are triggered by spamming keys. Be sure to give them a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/89dc77195f2356cece665da8e3deb611baeff195.gif[/img]


[b]2. Grabs[/b]
Grabs are best at handling the enemy that's caught up with you in close quarters.
Certain grabs make use of strikes and knives in combo skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/43b74b38f2b7e00c7687b143bd919a25c0363ee9.gif[/img]


[b]3. Counter-Attacks[/b]
These are the skills that help you parry and strike back at melee fighters.
Timing is the essence of the skill. Get it right and you'll come out on top in close-quarter combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/271e5ee63c9b285da3c6e2a513f72beef4dfce48.gif[/img]


[b]4. Throws[/b]								
Throws allow you to attack mid-range enemies.								
Masters have a wide range of skills and equipment at their disposal: namely, bleed-inflicting daggers, bombs with area-of-effect damage, status effect attacks, and electrocuting skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/af0f4e4a222fb075bab1abe9dbc766938fcb40b4.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/ccf2879405d65b31691996db7f7cfffe3fc49397.gif[/img]				


[b]5. Mobility Skills[/b]
All Masters have a special moving skill that's triggered with the Shift key.
Knowing how to make use of this skill is absolutely vital for your mobility, chance to dodge, and survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/afed08f6ba48256c6a369b187afcd22d4f19ff46.gif[/img]



[h3][b]Boosters[/b][/h3]

Boosters help Masters reach their full potential.
Get locked and loaded with boosters to get that edge in battle!


[b]1. Physical Boosters[/b]
Improves the Master's physical abilities such as their health recovery and moving speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/912fe29753e11904f8e208751e6108617fd9398f.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/850e64cc0f861c7ee21dc48e967a00541a4082c5.gif[/img]


[b]2. Aim-related Boosters[/b]
Assists players by decreasing the aiming point, increasing the aiming speed, adding recoil control, and many others.

Before Booster Use

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/6bf378f924cb518836a312008621b873ce880d90.gif[/img]


 After Booster Use

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/66ac07de6c14e95cd768f639e8fa96ad6f843c6e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Allow us to explain the Basic controls of BLACK STIGMA for the latest members.
notes.content:
Let's go over the basic controls of BLACK STIGMA for the benefit of the newly initiated.



[h3][b]Moving[/b][/h3]

Press WASD to move forward/back or to the left/right.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/17365e1395936c9c81558067fb9ceff48f61b422.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/042355730547e40400e782b6f79f1ca1d7fcae37.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/f4a2e01a078b19c942df6c9b37d00cc34b186d2c.gif[/img] [img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/c4cd8c3c2abbcb714b2d9d4c5d1a300133b3e7d2.gif[/img]



[h3][b]Interactions[/b][/h3]		

Press F to Interact with the environment.
F can be used in a variety of situations, including.
				
Picking up weapons

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/08fb70edcfdfe25f22f06060100458bfa8a750f6.gif[/img]


Climbing a structure

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/08d8bb1047b6d259a84e75dcaa03cb8de53edc19.gif[/img]


	
[h3][b]Sitting Position[/b][/h3]	

Press Ctrl to take a sitting position.
This will allow you to conceal yourself from the enemy's attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/fa1fc004415e899ffa5c59f2956963f0be1efa1b.gif[/img]


Moving while crouching will muffle your footsteps and allow you to sneak up on the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/ad68a5380fddf683f1ce66c17b7887d9c09b0e6f.gif[/img]


Taking a sitting position while shooting increases stability and greatly assists your accuracy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/05385c0647e39f4e2b8c22dded6b24ece3fb6b4f.gif[/img]



[h3][b]Show Skill Tips[/b][/h3]	

Press F1 to check your Master's active skills.
All Masters have unique active skills that can lead you to victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/cba6cae7a3db6ace82ad72ba4e607c249d1bcd8f.gif[/img]



[h3][b]You might be wondering where "Running" and "Jumping" controls are at.[/b][/h3]	

BLACK STIGMA revolutionizes how hand-to-hand combat is handled in shooting games.
Press Shift to test out unique mobility skills of the Masters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/c34a17415b941f891809416780a64cfebe7d4f74.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/1ba8f4c45391fb633a92b403074a6b9a817ee1e1.gif[/img]


While there's no separate Jump key, you can interact with the environment via F to achieve a desired result in most cases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819793/f1845672a31a19fe93b35e7112c516f78684cd98.gif[/img]
